ex.cn: 各种想法在我头脑里逐渐明朗起来。

ex.cn: 那天，一切都很顺利。

senses.def: paper covered with gelatin, used in photography

covered with ice or very cold

senses.def: a precious stone that has been cut and polished and is used in jewellery

ex.en: a crown studded with gems
ex.cn: 镶有宝石的皇冠

senses.def: a person, place or thing that is especially good
senses.chn: 难能可贵的人；风景优美的地方；美妙绝伦的事物

ex.en: This picture is the gem (= the best) of the collection.
ex.cn: 这幅画是收藏中的极品。

ex.cn: 胜地

ex.en: She's a real gem!
ex.cn: 她真是难能可贵！

senses.def: consisting of the same consonant pronounced twice, for example /kk/ in the middle of the word backcomb

senses.chn: 属双子座的人（约出生于 5 月 22 日至 6 月 21 日）

senses.def: information
to find out or give sb information about sth
senses.chn: 了解情况；知道详情；向（某人）提供情报

senses.def: a member of the French police force
the fact of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, not differences in biology
senses.chn: 性别（尤指社会和文化差异，而非生理差异）

ex.cn: 阶级、种族和性别问题

ex.en: traditional concepts of gender
ex.cn: 传统的性别观念

ex.en: gender differences/relations/roles
ex.cn: 性别差异／关系／角色

ex.en: My daughter prefers to see a woman doctor.
ex.cn: 我的女儿喜欢让女医生看病。

ex.en: They have a male nanny for their kids.
ex.cn: 他们有个男保姆照料孩子。

ex.en: a female racing driver
ex.cn: 女赛车手

senses.def: each of the classes ( masculine, feminine and sometimes neuter) into which nouns, pronouns and adjectives are divided; the division of nouns, pronouns and adjectives into these different genders. Different genders may have different endings, etc.
senses.chn: 性（阳性、阴性和中性，不同的性有不同的词尾等）

ex.en: In French the adjective must agree with the noun in number and gender.
ex.cn: 法语中形容词必须在数和性上与名词一致。

senses.chn: 穿着举止像异性的人；假小子；假娘儿们

senses.chn: 性别焦虑症，性别不安（指在心理上无法认同自己的生理性别）

senses.chn: 性别再造手术；变性手术

senses.def: connected with women only or with men only
senses.chn: 女（或男）性特有的；与某一性别有关的

ex.en: The report was redrafted to remove gender-specific language.
ex.cn: 重新起草了这个报告，删除了带有性别特点的语言。

senses.def: a unit inside a cell which controls a particular quality in a living thing that has been passed on from its parents

ex.en: a dominant/recessive gene
ex.cn: 显性／隐性基因

ex.en: genes that code for the colour of the eyes
ex.cn: 为眼睛的颜色编码的基因

senses.def: to be a quality that your parents have passed on to you

ex.cn: 我向来喜欢音乐，这是遗传的。

senses.def: a person who studies family history
senses.chn: 家谱学者；系谱学家；宗谱学家

senses.def: the study of family history, including the study of who the ancestors of a particular person were
a particular person's line of ancestors; a diagram that shows this
all of the genes that are available within breeding populations of a particular species of animal or plant
senses.chn: 基因库（某物种的全部基因）

senses.def: affecting all or most people, places or things

ex.en: The general opinion is that the conference was a success.
ex.cn: 普遍认为这次会议是成功的。

ex.en: the general belief/consensus
ex.cn: 普遍的信念／共识

ex.en: books of general interest (= of interest to most people)
ex.cn: 普遍感兴趣的书籍

ex.en: The bad weather has been fairly general (= has affected most areas).
ex.cn: 坏天气影响到的范围相当大。

senses.def: normal; usual

ex.en: There is one exception to this general principle.
ex.cn: 这个一般性原则有一例外。

ex.en: As a general rule (= usually) he did what he could to be helpful.
ex.cn: 一般情况下他都尽力给予帮助。

ex.en: This opinion is common among the general population (= ordinary people).
ex.cn: 这是人们普遍的看法。

senses.def: including the most important aspects of sth; not exact or detailed
senses.chn: 概括性的；大体的；笼统的

ex.en: I check the bookings to get a general idea of what activities to plan.
ex.cn: 我核查预订情况以便对计划安排些什么活动有个大体的想法。

ex.en: I know how it works in general terms.
ex.cn: 我大致知道其中的运作原理。

ex.en: They gave a general description of the man.
ex.cn: 他们对这个男人作了大致的描述。

senses.def: approximately, but not exactly, the direction/area mentioned
senses.chn: 大致的，大概的（方向或地区）

ex.en: They fired in the general direction of the enemy.
ex.cn: 他们向敌军大致的方向开了枪。

senses.def: not limited to a particular subject, use or activity
senses.chn: 非专门的；一般性的；普通的

ex.en: a general hospital
ex.cn: 综合医院

ex.en: general education
ex.cn: 普通教育

ex.en: We shall keep the discussion fairly general.
ex.cn: 我们会保持相当广泛的讨论。

senses.def: not limited to one part or aspect of a person or thing

ex.en: a general anaesthetic
ex.cn: 全身麻醉

ex.en: The building was in a general state of disrepair.
ex.cn: 整座建筑处于失修状态。

senses.def: highest in rank; chief

ex.en: the general manager
ex.cn: 总经理

ex.en: the Inspector General of Police
ex.cn: 警察总监

senses.def: usually; mainly

ex.en: In general, Japanese cars are very reliable and breakdowns are rare.
ex.cn: 日本汽车通常是很可靠的，发生故障的情况极少。

ex.en: In conclusion, the study has provided useful insights into the issues relating to people's perception of crime.
ex.cn: 综上所述，本研究为人们对犯罪活动的认识问题提供了有益的见解。

ex.en: Based on this study, it can be concluded that the introduction of new street lighting did not reduce reported crime.
ex.cn: 基于这项研究可以得出这样的结论：增加街道照明设备并没有使犯罪案件报案数量减少。

ex.en: To sum up, no evidence can be found to support the view that improved street lighting reduces reported crime.
ex.cn: 总而言之，没有证据表明街道照明的改进能使犯罪案件报案数量减少。

ex.en: The available evidence clearly leads to the conclusion that the media do have an influence on the public perception of crime.
ex.cn: 现有证据显然可以得出这一结论：公众对犯罪活动的认识确实受到媒体的影响。

ex.en: The main conclusion to be drawn from this study is that public perception of crime is significantly influenced by crime news reporting.
ex.cn: 本研究可以得出的一个主要结论是：公众对犯罪活动的认识受到犯罪新闻报道的很大影响。

senses.def: as a whole

ex.en: This is a crucial year for your relationships in general and your love life in particular.
ex.cn: 这一年总体上对你们的关系，特别是你们的爱情生活是非常关键的。

senses.def: an officer of very high rank in the army and the US air force; the officer with the highest rank in the marines
senses.chn: 将军；（陆军、海军陆战队或美国空军）上将

ex.en: a four-star general
ex.cn: 四星上将

ex.en: General Tom Parker
ex.cn: 汤姆 · 帕克将军

senses.def: the way people speak English in most parts of the US, not including New England, New York, and the South
senses.chn: 通用美式英语（除新英格兰、纽约和南方等之外通用于美国大部分地区）

senses.def: (in the US) the main lawyer who gives legal advice to a company
an arrangement in which a post office keeps a person's mail until they go to collect it, used especially when sb is travelling
senses.chn: 邮件寄存服务，存局候领（邮局暂为保管以候收件人上门自取）

senses.def: an election in which all the people of a country vote to choose a government
a person who commands all the armed forces of a country, especially one who has political as well as military power
senses.chn: 大元帅；三军总司令；（尤指兼掌军政大权的）最高统帅

senses.def: a person who has knowledge of several different subjects or activities
a statement that discusses general principles or issues rather than details or particular examples

ex.en: to speak in broad generalities
ex.cn: 泛泛地说

ex.en: As usual, he confined his comments to generalities.
ex.cn: 他和往常一样，只作了笼统的评论。

senses.def: most of a group of people or things

ex.en: This view is held by the generality of leading scholars.
ex.cn: 大多数知名学者都持这种观点。

senses.def: the quality of being general rather than detailed or exact

ex.en: An account of such generality is of little value.
ex.cn: 这种一般性描述没有什么价值。

senses.def: a general statement that is based on only a few facts or examples; the act of making such statements

ex.en: a speech full of broad/sweeping generalizations
ex.cn: 通篇大而无当的发言

ex.en: to make generalizations about sth
ex.cn: 对某事做出归纳

ex.en: Try to avoid generalization.
ex.cn: 尽量避免泛泛而论。

senses.def: to use a particular set of facts or ideas in order to form an opinion that is considered valid for a different situation

ex.en: It would be foolish to generalize from a single example.
ex.cn: 仅从一个事例进行归纳的做法是愚蠢的。

senses.def: to make a general statement about sth and not look at the details

ex.en: It is dangerous to generalize about the poor.
ex.cn: 对穷人一概而论是危险的。

senses.def: to apply a theory, idea, etc. to a wider group or situation than the original one
senses.chn: 扩大…的运用；将…类推到（较大的范围）

ex.en: These conclusions cannot be generalized to the whole country.
ex.cn: 这些结论不能推及全国。

senses.def: not detailed; not limited to one particular area
senses.chn: 笼统的；普遍的；概括性的；全面的

ex.en: a generalized discussion
ex.cn: 笼统的讨论

ex.en: a generalized disease/rash (= affecting the whole body)
ex.cn: 全身性疾病／疹子

senses.def: knowledge of facts about a lot of different subjects

ex.en: a general knowledge quiz
ex.cn: 常识问答比赛

senses.def: by or to most people

ex.en: The plan was generally welcomed.
ex.cn: 这个计划受到普遍的欢迎。

ex.en: It is now generally accepted that…
ex.cn: 目前，人们普遍认为…

ex.en: The new drug will be generally available from January.
ex.cn: 这种新药从一月份开始将可大量上市。

ex.en: He was a generally unpopular choice for captain.
ex.cn: 人们普遍不欢迎他当队长。

senses.def: in most cases

ex.en: I generally get up at six.
ex.cn: 我一般六点钟起床。

ex.en: The male is generally larger with a shorter beak.
ex.cn: 雄鸟通常体形较大，喙较短。

ex.en: Women generally earn less than men.
ex.cn: 女人通常比男人挣钱少。

ex.en: Generally speaking, jobs traditionally done by women are paid at a lower rate than those traditionally done by men.
ex.cn: 一般来说，传统上由妇女干的工作比传统上由男人干的工作报酬低。

ex.en: In general / By and large, women do not earn as much as men.
ex.cn: 总的说来，女人不如男人挣钱多。

ex.en: Certain jobs, like nursing and cleaning, are still mainly carried out by women.
ex.cn: 有些工作仍然主要由女性做，比如护理和保洁。

senses.def: without discussing the details of sth

ex.en: Let's talk just about investment generally.
ex.cn: 咱们只大概谈谈投资吧。

senses.def: the work of a doctor who treats people in the community rather than at a hospital and who is not a specialist in one particular area of medicine; a place where a doctor like this works
senses.chn: （医院以外的）综合医疗，全科诊疗；全科诊所

ex.en: to be in general practice
ex.cn: 从事普通诊疗

ex.en: She runs a general practice in Hull.
ex.cn: 她在赫尔开了家全科诊所。

senses.def: the work of a lawyer who deals with all kinds of legal cases and who is not a specialist in one particular area of law; the place where a lawyer like this works
senses.chn: 普通律师业务；普通律师事务所

senses.def: a doctor who is trained in general medicine and who treats patients in a local community rather than at a hospital
senses.chn: （医院以外的）全科医生，普通医师

senses.def: having a wide range of different uses

ex.en: a general-purpose farm vehicle
ex.cn: 多功能农用机动车

senses.def: the skill or practice of leading an army during a battle
senses.chn: 将军才能；将才；将军职能

senses.def: officers who advise a military leader and help to plan a military operation
a shop/store that sells a wide variety of goods, especially one in a small town or village
senses.chn: （尤指小城镇或乡村的）杂货店

senses.def: a period of time when most or all of the workers in a country go on strike
to produce or create sth

ex.en: to generate electricity/heat/power
ex.cn: 发电；产生热／动力

ex.en: to generate income/profit
ex.cn: 产生收益／利润

ex.en: We need someone to generate new ideas.
ex.cn: 我们需要有人出新主意。

ex.en: The proposal has generated a lot of interest.
ex.cn: 这项建议引起众多的关注。

ex.en: She makes her own clothes.
ex.cn: 她自己做衣服。

ex.en: She made a good impression on the interviewer.
ex.cn: 她给主持面试者留下了很好的印象。

senses.def: all the people who were born at about the same time

ex.en: the younger/older generation
ex.cn: 年轻的一代；老一辈

ex.en: My generation have grown up without the experience of a world war.
ex.cn: 我这一代人在成长过程中没有经历过世界大战。

ex.en: I often wonder what future generations will make of our efforts.
ex.cn: 我常常想，后代将怎样评价我们所作出的努力。

senses.def: the average time in which children grow up, become adults and have children of their own, (usually considered to be about 30 years)
senses.chn: 代，一代，一辈（通常认为大约 30 年）

ex.en: a generation ago
ex.cn: 一代人以前

ex.en: My family have lived in this house for generations.
ex.cn: 我家祖祖辈辈都住在这房子里。

senses.def: a single stage in the history of a family

ex.en: stories passed down from generation to generation
ex.cn: 世代相传的故事

ex.en: a first-/second-generation American (= a person whose family has lived in America for one/two generations)
ex.cn: 第一／第二代美国人（家人在美国居住了一、二代者）

senses.def: a group of people of similar age involved in a particular activity
senses.chn: 一批，一届（从事特定活动的同龄人）

ex.en: She has inspired a whole generation of fashion school graduates.
ex.cn: 她激励了整整一届时装学校的毕业生。

senses.def: a stage in the development of a product, usually a technical one
senses.chn: （产品发展，尤指技术方面的）代

ex.en: fifth-generation computing
ex.cn: 第五代计算机技术

ex.en: a new generation of vehicle
ex.cn: 新一代交通运输工具

senses.def: the production of sth, especially electricity, heat, etc.

ex.en: the generation of electricity
ex.cn: 发电

ex.en: methods of income generation
ex.cn: 产生收益的方法

senses.def: connected with a particular generation or with the relationship between different generations

ex.en: generational conflict
ex.cn: 两代人之间的冲突

senses.def: the group of people who were born between the early 1960s and the middle of the 1970s, who seem to lack a sense of direction in life and to feel that they have no part to play in society *
senses.chn: X 一代（20 世纪 60 年代初至 70 年代中期出生的人，对人生似乎失去方向，对社会感到格格不入）

senses.def: the group of people who were born between the early 1980s and the end of the 1990s, who are mainly the children of the baby boomers and who are regarded as being very familiar with computers and electronic technology *
senses.chn: Y 一代（20 世纪 80 年代初至 90 年代末出生的人，被认为对电脑和电子技术非常熟悉）

senses.def: that can produce sth
senses.chn: 有生产力的；能生产的；有生殖力的

ex.en: generative processes
ex.cn: 生产过程

senses.def: a type of grammar which describes a language by giving a set of rules which can be used to produce all the possible sentences in that language
a machine for producing electricity

ex.en: The factory's emergency generators were used during the power cut.
ex.cn: 工厂应急发电机在停电期间用上了。

ex.en: a wind generator (= a machine that uses the power of the wind to produce electricity)
ex.cn: 风力发电机

senses.def: a machine for producing a particular substance

ex.en: The museum uses smells and smoke generators to create atmosphere.
ex.cn: 博物馆利用气味和烟雾发生器制造气氛。

ex.en: The company is a major generator of jobs.
ex.cn: 这家公司创造了相当多的就业机会。

senses.def: a company that produces electricity to sell to the public

ex.en: the UK's major electricity generator
ex.cn: 英国主要的电力公司

senses.def: shared by, including or typical of a whole group of things; not specific

ex.en: 'Vine fruit' is the generic term for currants and raisins.
ex.cn: vine fruit 是有核和无核葡萄干的通称。

senses.def: not using the name of the company that made it
senses.chn: 无厂家商标的；无商标的

ex.en: The doctor offered me a choice of a branded or a generic drug.
ex.cn: 医生让我选择用有商标的还是没有商标的药物。

senses.def: the fact of being generous (= willing to give sb money, gifts, time or kindness freely)

ex.en: He treated them with generosity and thoughtfulness.
ex.cn: 他待他们宽容大度、体贴周到。

senses.def: giving or willing to give freely; given freely
senses.chn: 慷慨的；大方的；慷慨给予的

ex.en: a generous benefactor
ex.cn: 慷慨的捐助者

ex.en: to be generous with your time
ex.cn: 不吝惜时间

ex.en: to be generous in giving help
ex.cn: 乐于助人

ex.en: a generous gift/offer
ex.cn: 丰厚的礼物；慷慨的提议

ex.en: It was generous of him to offer to pay for us both.
ex.cn: 他主动为我们俩付钱，真是大方。

senses.def: more than is necessary; large

ex.en: a generous helping of meat
ex.cn: 一大份肉

ex.en: The car has a generous amount of space.
ex.cn: 这辆汽车的空间很大。

senses.def: kind in the way you treat people; willing to see what is good about sb/sth
senses.chn: 宽厚的；宽宏大量的；仁慈的

ex.en: a generous mind
ex.cn: 宽阔的胸怀

ex.en: He wrote a very generous assessment of my work.
ex.cn: 他给我写的工作评价多有赞誉之词。

example.en: to be generous with your time
example.cn: 不吝惜时间

senses.def: the beginning or origin of sth
a wild animal similar to a cat but with a longer tail and body and a pointed head. Genets are found in Africa, southern Europe and Asia and eat insects and small animals.
senses.chn: 𧴌（栖息于非洲、欧洲南部和亚洲）

senses.def: a treatment in which normal genes are put into cells to replace ones that are missing or not normal
connected with genes (= the units in the cells of a living thing that control its physical characteristics) or genetics (= the study of genes)

ex.en: genetic and environmental factors
ex.cn: 遗传和环境因素

ex.en: genetic abnormalities
ex.cn: 基因异常

senses.def: (of a plant, etc.) having had its genetic structure changed artificially, so that it will produce more fruit or not be affected by disease
senses.chn: （植物等）遗传修饰的，转基因的

ex.en: genetically modified foods (= made from plants that have been changed in this way)
ex.cn: 转基因食品

senses.def: the arrangement of genes that controls how each living thing will develop
the science of changing how a living creature or plant develops by changing the information in its genes
the method of finding the particular pattern of genes in an individual person, particularly to identify sb or find out if sb has committed a crime
senses.chn: 基因指纹分析；遗传指纹法

ex.cn: 她示意让他们进来。

ex.en: He gestured (to me) that it was time to go.
ex.cn: 他示意（我）该走了。

ex.en: They gestured that I should follow.
ex.cn: 他们示意让我跟在后面。

example.en: 'I see you read a lot,' he said, gesturing at the wall of books.
example.cn: “看来你读的书很多。” 他指着那一墙的书说道。

phrases.filled: gesture for sb to do sth

example.en: She gestured for them to come in.
example.cn: 她示意让他们进来。

example.en: He gestured (to me) that it was time to go.
example.cn: 他示意（我）该走了。

senses.def: used when sb has sneezed to wish them good health
to receive sth

ex.en: I got a letter from Dave this morning.
ex.cn: 今天早上我收到戴夫的一封来信。

ex.en: What (= What presents) did you get for your birthday?
ex.cn: 你收到什么生日礼物了？

ex.en: He gets (= earns) about $40 000 a year.
ex.cn: 他一年挣 4 万美元左右。

ex.en: This room gets very little sunshine.
ex.cn: 这个房间几乎照不进阳光。

ex.en: I got a shock when I saw the bill.
ex.cn: 我看到账单时大吃一惊。

ex.en: I get the impression that he is bored with his job.
ex.cn: 我的印象是他厌倦他的工作。

senses.def: to obtain sth

ex.en: Where did you get (= buy) that skirt?
ex.cn: 你在哪儿买的那条裙子？

ex.en: Did you manage to get tickets for the concert?
ex.cn: 你弄到音乐会的票了吗？

ex.en: She opened the door wider to get a better look.
ex.cn: 她把门开大些以便看得更清楚。

ex.en: Try to get some sleep.
ex.cn: 尽量睡会儿吧。

ex.en: He has just got a new job.
ex.cn: 他刚找到一份新工作。

ex.en: Did you get a present for your mother?
ex.cn: 给你母亲买礼物了吗？

senses.def: to obtain or receive an amount of money by selling sth

ex.en: How much did you get for your car?
ex.cn: 你的汽车卖了多少钱？

senses.def: to go to a place and bring sb/sth back

ex.en: Quick— go and get a cloth!
ex.cn: 快，去拿块布来！

ex.en: Somebody get a doctor!
ex.cn: 谁去叫个医生来吧！

ex.en: I have to go and get my mother from the airport (= collect her).
ex.cn: 我得去机场接我的母亲。

ex.en: Get a drink for John.
ex.cn: 给约翰拿杯饮料来。

ex.en: Get John a drink.
ex.cn: 给约翰拿杯饮料来。

senses.def: to receive sth as a punishment

ex.en: He got ten years (= was sent to prison for ten years) for armed robbery.
ex.cn: 他因持枪抢劫被判刑十年。

senses.def: to receive broadcasts from a particular television or radio station

ex.en: We can't get Channel 5 in our area.
ex.cn: 我们地区收不到 5 频道的节目。

senses.def: to buy sth, for example a newspaper or magazine, regularly

ex.en: Which newspaper do you get?
ex.cn: 你订阅什么报纸？

senses.def: to achieve or be given a particular mark/grade in an exam

ex.en: He got a 'C' in Chemistry and a 'B' in English.
ex.cn: 他化学考试得中，英语考试得良。

senses.def: to become infected with an illness; to suffer from a pain, etc.

ex.en: I got this cold off (= from) you!
ex.cn: 我这感冒是被你传染的！

ex.en: She gets (= often suffers from) really bad headaches.
ex.cn: 她经常头痛得厉害。

senses.def: to be connected with sb by telephone
senses.chn: 与（某人）电话联系；与（某人）通电话

ex.en: I wanted to speak to the manager but I got his secretary instead.
ex.cn: 我想与经理说话，可接电话的却是他的秘书。

senses.def: to reach a particular state or condition; to make sb/sth/yourself reach a particular state or condition

ex.en: to get angry/bored/hungry/fat
ex.cn: 发怒；生厌；饥饿；发胖

ex.en: You'll soon get used to the climate here.
ex.cn: 你会很快习惯这儿的气候的。

ex.en: We ought to go; it's getting late.
ex.cn: 我们该走了，天色越来越晚了。

ex.en: to get dressed/undressed (= to put your clothes on/take your clothes off)
ex.cn: 穿上／脱下衣服

ex.en: They plan to get married in the summer.
ex.cn: 他们打算夏天结婚。

ex.en: She's upstairs getting ready.
ex.cn: 她在楼上做准备。

senses.def: to reach the point at which you feel, know, are, etc. sth
senses.chn: 开始（感觉到、认识到、成为）；达到…地步（或程度）

ex.en: After a time you get to realize that these things don't matter.
ex.cn: 过段时间你会明白这些事情并不要紧。

ex.en: You'll like her once you get to know her.
ex.cn: 你一旦了解了她就会喜欢她的。

ex.en: His drinking is getting to be a problem.
ex.cn: 他的酗酒越来越成问题了。

ex.en: She's getting to be an old lady now.
ex.cn: 她现在都快是个老太婆了。

senses.def: to make, persuade, etc. sb/sth to do sth
senses.chn: 使，让（某人或物做某事）；说服（某人做某事）

ex.en: I couldn't get the car to start this morning.
ex.cn: 我今天早上没法让这汽车发动起来。

ex.en: He got his sister to help him with his homework.
ex.cn: 他让姐姐帮助他做家庭作业。

ex.en: You'll never get him to understand.
ex.cn: 你永远不会使他明白的。

ex.en: Can you really get that old car going again?
ex.cn: 你真能让那老爷车再跑起来吗？

ex.en: It's not hard to get him talking—the problem is stopping him!
ex.cn: 让他谈话并不难，难的是让他住口！

senses.def: to cause sth to happen or be done
senses.chn: 使（某事）发生；使完成（某事）

ex.en: I must get my hair cut.
ex.cn: 我得理发了。

ex.en: I'll never get all this work finished.
ex.cn: 这么多的工作我怎么也干不完。

senses.def: to start doing sth

ex.en: I got talking to her.
ex.cn: 我开始与她谈起来。

ex.en: We need to get going soon.
ex.cn: 我们需要马上出发。

senses.def: to have the opportunity to do sth
senses.chn: 有机会（做某事）；得到（做某事的）机会

ex.en: He got to try out all the new software.
ex.cn: 他得以试用了所有的新软件。

ex.en: It's not fair—I never get to go first.
ex.cn: 这不公平，我从来没有机会先走。

senses.def: to arrive at or reach a place or point

ex.en: We got to San Diego at 7 o'clock.
ex.cn: 我们 7 点钟到达了圣迭戈。

ex.en: You got in very late last night.
ex.cn: 你昨晚回来得很晚。

ex.en: What time did you get here?
ex.cn: 你什么时候到达这儿的？

ex.en: I haven't got very far with the book I'm reading.
ex.cn: 我那本书还没读多少呢。

senses.def: to move to or from a particular place or in a particular direction, sometimes with difficulty; to make sb/sth do this
senses.chn: （使）到达，离开，沿…移动，艰难地移动

ex.en: The bridge was destroyed so we couldn't get across the river.
ex.cn: 大桥已经毁坏，我们无法过河了。

ex.en: She got into bed.
ex.cn: 她上床睡觉了。

ex.en: He got down from the ladder.
ex.cn: 他从梯子上下来了。

ex.en: We didn't get (= go) to bed until 3 a.m.
ex.cn: 我们直到凌晨 3 点才上床睡觉。

ex.en: Where do we get on the bus?
ex.cn: 我们在哪儿上公共汽车？

ex.en: I'm getting off (= leaving the train) at the next station.
ex.cn: 我在下一站下车。

senses.def: to use a bus, taxi, plane, etc.
senses.chn: 搭乘，乘坐（公共汽车、出租车、飞机等）

ex.en: We're going to be late—let's get a taxi.
ex.cn: 我们要迟到了，咱们坐出租车吧。

ex.en: I usually get the bus to work.
ex.cn: 我通常坐公共汽车上班。

senses.def: to prepare a meal

ex.en: Who's getting the lunch?
ex.cn: 谁来做午饭？

ex.en: I must go home and get tea for the kids.
ex.cn: 我得回家为孩子们准备茶点。

ex.en: I must go home and get the kids their tea.
ex.cn: 我得回家为孩子们准备茶点。

senses.def: to answer the telephone or a door when sb calls, knocks, etc.

ex.en: Will you get the phone?
ex.cn: 你去接一下电话好吗？

senses.def: to catch or take hold of sb, especially in order to harm or punish them
senses.chn: （尤指为伤害或惩罚）抓住，捉住，逮住

ex.en: He was on the run for a week before the police got him.
ex.cn: 他逃跑一周后警方才将他逮住。

ex.en: to get sb by the arm/wrist/throat
ex.cn: 抓住某人的胳膊／手腕；掐住某人的喉咙

ex.en: She fell overboard and the sharks got her.
ex.cn: 她从船上跌入水中被鲨鱼咬了。

ex.en: He thinks everybody is out to get him (= trying to harm him).
ex.cn: 他认为所有人都想害他。

ex.en: I'll get you for that!
ex.cn: 这事我跟你没完！

senses.def: to hit or wound sb

ex.en: The bullet got him in the neck.
ex.cn: 子弹击中了他的颈部。

senses.def: to understand sb/sth

ex.en: I don't get you.
ex.cn: 我搞不懂你的意思。

ex.en: She didn't get the joke.
ex.cn: 她不明白那笑话的含义。

ex.en: I don't get it —why would she do a thing like that?
ex.cn: 我不明白，她怎么会干那种事？

ex.en: I get the message —you don't want me to come.
ex.cn: 我明白这意思，你是不希望我来。

ex.en: I don't understand the instructions.
ex.cn: 我不懂这些指令的意思。

ex.en: Doctors still don't understand much about the disease.
ex.cn: 医生对这种疾病还了解不多。

senses.def: used to say that sth happens or exists

ex.en: You get (= There are) all these kids hanging around in the street.
ex.cn: 所有这些孩子都在街上闲逛。

ex.en: They still get cases of typhoid there.
ex.cn: 他们那儿仍有伤寒病发生。

senses.def: to make sb feel confused because they do not understand sth

ex.en: 'What's the capital of Bhutan?' ' You've got me there! ' (= I don't know)
ex.cn: “不丹的首都在什么地方？” “你可把我难倒了！”

senses.def: to annoy sb

ex.en: What gets me is having to do the same thing all day long.
ex.cn: 使我感到烦恼的是整天都得干同样的事。

senses.def: to be becoming old
to be becoming late

ex.en: The time's getting on—we ought to be going.
ex.cn: 时间越来越晚了，我们该走了。

senses.def: to be nearly a particular time, age or number
senses.chn: 接近（某时刻、年龄或数目）

ex.en: It must be getting on for midnight.
ex.cn: 一定快到半夜了。

ex.en: He's getting on for eighty.
ex.cn: 他近八十岁了。

senses.def: used to say that you are shocked, surprised, amused, etc. by sth
senses.chn: 因…而感到震惊（或惊讶、好笑等）

ex.en: I can't get over how rude she was.
ex.cn: 她这么粗鲁真使我感到惊讶。

senses.def: to have a short holiday/vacation in a place where you can relax
to be punished or spoken to angrily about sth
to have sex with sb
to have an erection
to make sb angry, worried or excited
senses.chn: 激怒某人；使某人担忧（或激动）

senses.def: to not help sb make progress or succeed
senses.chn: 使无所进展（或成就）；徒劳

ex.en: This line of investigation is getting us nowhere.
ex.cn: 这种调查方式不会使我们得到任何结果。

ex.en: Being rude to me won't get you anywhere.
ex.cn: 你对我撒野也没有用。

senses.def: to make some progress/no progress

ex.en: After six months' work on the project, at last I feel I'm getting somewhere.
ex.cn: 那个项目干了六个月之后我终于感到有了一些进展。

ex.en: I don't seem to be getting anywhere with this letter.
ex.cn: 我的这封信看样子没什么效果。

senses.def: to achieve your aim or complete a task
senses.chn: 达到目的；完成任务；获得成功

ex.en: I'm sure you'll get there in the end.
ex.cn: 我相信你最终会成功的。

ex.en: It's not perfect but we're getting there (= making progress).
ex.cn: 虽然这并非完美无瑕，但我们正朝着目标前进。

senses.def: used to say that you are going to tell sb sth that they will find surprising or interesting
senses.chn: 听好了（用于表示要告诉大家令人吃惊或有趣的事情）

ex.en: OK, get this guys—there are only two left!
ex.cn: 好吧，听好了，伙计们，只剩两个了！

senses.def: used to express surprise or disapproval that sb has been so selfish, etc.
senses.chn: （表示惊奇或不赞成）你怎么这么自私（或愚蠢、忘恩负义等）

senses.def: you have to admit that sth unpleasant is true
senses.chn: 不容否认，只好承认（不愉快的事实）

senses.def: used to ask, especially in an angry way, what sb is/was suggesting
senses.chn: （尤指气愤地问）你（或他等）这话是什么意思，你（或他等）用意何在

ex.en: I'm partly to blame? What exactly are you getting at?
ex.cn: 我应负部分责任？你究竟是什么意思？

senses.def: used to say that sb has suddenly started to behave in a strange or different way
senses.chn: （表示某人突然行为反常起来）…怎么啦

ex.en: What's got into Alex? He never used to worry like that.
ex.cn: 亚历克斯怎么啦？他以前从未那样愁过。

senses.def: to have too high an opinion of yourself
senses.chn: 自以为了不起；自高自大；自视甚高

senses.def: to be communicated or understood; to succeed in communicating sth
senses.chn: 被传达；被理解；把…讲清楚

ex.en: Your meaning didn't really get across.
ex.cn: 你的意思并未真正为别人理解。

ex.en: He's not very good at getting his ideas across.
ex.cn: 他不太善于清楚地表达自己的思想。

senses.def: to make progress (further than others have done)
senses.chn: 走在（某人的）前面；领先；胜过（某人）

ex.en: She wants to get ahead in her career.
ex.cn: 她想在事业上脱颖而出。

ex.en: He soon got ahead of the others in his class.
ex.cn: 他很快就在班上名列前茅了。

senses.def: to leave a place

ex.en: It's time we were getting along.
ex.cn: 我们该离开了。

senses.def: to move from place to place or from person to person

ex.en: She gets around with the help of a stick.
ex.cn: 她拄着拐杖四处走动。

ex.en: News soon got around that he had resigned.
ex.cn: 他已辞职的消息很快传开了。

senses.def: to keep criticizing sb
senses.chn: 一再批评，不断指责，老是数落（某人）

ex.en: He's always getting at me.
ex.cn: 他老是责备我。

ex.en: She feels she's being got at.
ex.cn: 她感到自己总是受人数落。

senses.def: to reach sb/sth; to gain access to sb/sth
senses.chn: 到达某处；接近某人（或某物）；够得着某物

ex.en: The files are locked up and I can't get at them.
ex.cn: 文件资料锁起来了，我取不出来。

senses.def: to learn or find out sth

ex.en: The truth is sometimes difficult to get at.
ex.cn: 有时真相很难查明。

senses.def: to have a holiday/vacation

ex.en: We're hoping to get away for a few days at Easter.
ex.cn: 我们期待着复活节出去休几天假。

senses.def: used to show that you do not believe or are surprised by what sb has said

ex.en: 'These tickets didn't cost me a thing.' 'Get away!'
ex.cn: “这些票我一分钱也没花。” “胡说！”

senses.def: to succeed in leaving a place

ex.en: I won't be able to get away from the office before 7.
ex.cn: 我 7 点钟之前无法离开办公室。

senses.def: to escape from sb or a place
to steal sth and escape with it

ex.en: Thieves got away with computer equipment worth $30 000.
ex.cn: 盗贼偷走了价值 3 万美元的计算机设备。

senses.def: to receive a relatively light punishment
senses.chn: 受到从轻发落（轻微惩罚）

ex.en: He was lucky to get away with only a fine.
ex.cn: 他算是万幸，只被罚款了事。

senses.def: to do sth wrong and not be punished for it

ex.en: Don't be tempted to cheat—you'll never get away with it.
ex.cn: 别想着作弊，作弊者一定会受到严惩。

ex.en: Nobody gets away with insulting me like that.
ex.cn: 任何人那样侮辱我都不会有好果子吃。

senses.def: to manage with less of sth than you might expect to need
senses.chn: 以（比预期少的事物）就能应付

ex.en: After the first month, you should be able to get away with one lesson a week.
ex.cn: 第一个月之后，每周上一次课就可以了。

senses.def: to return, especially to your home

ex.en: What time did you get back last night?
ex.cn: 你昨晚什么时候回家的？

ex.en: I waited a long time for him to return.
ex.cn: 我等他回来等了很长时间。

ex.en: Come back and visit again soon!
ex.cn: 请早点儿再回来探访！

ex.en: Do you ever want to go back to China?
ex.cn: 你想过回中国去吗？

ex.en: What time did you get back last night?
ex.cn: 你昨晚什么时候回家的？

ex.en: The weather got so bad that we had to turn back.
ex.cn: 天气变得非常恶劣，我们不得不循原路折回。

senses.def: to obtain sth again after having lost it
senses.chn: 寻回，找回，重新获得（丢失的东西）

ex.en: She's got her old job back.
ex.cn: 她已恢复原职。

ex.en: I never lend books—you never get them back.
ex.cn: 我的书从不外借，借出去就收不回来。

senses.def: to win an election after having lost the previous one
to do sth bad to sb who has done sth bad to you; to get revenge on sb

ex.en: I'll find a way of getting back at him!
ex.cn: 我会想法报复他的！

senses.def: to speak or write to sb again later, especially in order to give a reply
senses.chn: 以后再答复（或回复）某人

ex.en: I'll find out and get back to you.
ex.cn: 我查明之后再答复你。

senses.def: to return to sth

ex.en: Could we get back to the question of funding?
ex.cn: 我们回到资金问题上来好吗？

senses.def: to start a relationship with sb again, especially a romantic relationship, after having finished a previous relationship with the same person
senses.chn: （与某人，尤指恋人）重归于好，重修旧好

ex.en: I just got back together with my ex-girlfriend.
ex.cn: 我刚和前女友重修旧好。

senses.def: to fail to make enough progress or to produce sth at the right time

ex.en: I'm getting behind with my work.
ex.cn: 我的工作拖延了。

ex.en: He got behind with the payments for his car.
ex.cn: 他拖欠了买汽车的车款。

senses.def: to manage to live or do a particular thing using the money, knowledge, equipment, etc. that you have
senses.chn: （靠…）维持生计，设法过活，勉强应付

ex.en: How does she get by on such a small salary?
ex.cn: 她靠这点微薄的工资怎么过活？

ex.en: I can just about get by in German (= I can speak basic German).
ex.cn: 我用德语只能勉强应付。

senses.def: to leave the table after a meal
to make sb feel sad or depressed
to swallow sth, usually with difficulty
to make a note of sth

ex.en: Did you get his number down?
ex.cn: 你记下他的号码了吗？

senses.def: to begin to do sth; to give serious attention to sth
senses.chn: 开始做某事；开始认真注意（或对待）某事

ex.en: Let's get down to business.
ex.cn: 咱们开始干正事吧。

ex.en: I like to get down to work by 9.
ex.cn: 我喜欢在 9 点之前开始工作。

ex.en: It's time I got down to thinking about that essay.
ex.cn: 我该认真思考一下那篇论文了。

senses.def: to arrive at a place

ex.en: The train got in late.
ex.cn: 火车晚点到达。

ex.en: What time do you get into Heathrow?
ex.cn: 你什么时候到达希思罗机场？

senses.def: to win an election

ex.en: The Republican candidate stands a good chance of getting in.
ex.cn: 共和党候选人很可能当选。

ex.en: She first got into Parliament (= became an MP) in 2005.
ex.cn: 她 2005 年第一次当选为下议院议员。

senses.def: to be admitted to a school, university, etc.
senses.chn: 被录取；被接受入学（或入会等）

ex.en: She's got into Durham to study law.
ex.cn: 她被录取到杜伦大学学习法律。

senses.def: to call sb to your house to do a job
to collect or gather sth

ex.en: to get the crops/harvest in
ex.cn: 收获作物／庄稼

senses.def: to buy a supply of sth

ex.en: Remember to get in some beers for this evening.
ex.cn: 记住为今天的晚会买些啤酒。

senses.def: to manage to do or say sth

ex.en: I got in an hour's work while the baby was asleep.
ex.cn: 我趁孩子睡觉抽空干了一小时的活。

ex.en: She talks so much it's impossible to get a word in.
ex.cn: 她说起话来滔滔不绝，让人一句话都插不进去。

senses.def: to take part in an activity

ex.en: He's hoping to get in on any discussions about the new project.
ex.cn: 他盼望着参加有关这一新项目的任何讨论。

senses.def: to become friendly with sb, especially in order to gain an advantage
senses.chn: （尤指为捞取好处与某人）成为朋友，拉关系，套近乎

senses.def: to put on a piece of clothing, especially with difficulty

ex.en: I can't get into these shoes—they're too small.
ex.cn: 这双鞋太小，我穿不进去。

senses.def: to start a career in a particular profession

ex.en: What's the best way to get into journalism?
ex.cn: 进入新闻界的最佳途径是什么？

senses.def: to become involved in sth; to start sth

ex.en: I got into conversation with an Italian student.
ex.cn: 我与一位意大利学生谈了起来。

ex.en: to get into a fight
ex.cn: 参与斗殴

senses.def: to develop a particular habit

ex.en: Don't let yourself get into bad habits.
ex.cn: 别让自己染上恶习。

ex.en: You should get into the routine of saving the document you are working on every ten minutes.
ex.cn: 你应该养成每十分钟将正在编辑的文件存盘一次的习惯。

ex.en: How did she get into (= start taking) drugs?
ex.cn: 她是怎么染上毒品的？

senses.def: to become interested in sth

ex.en: I'm really getting into jazz these days.
ex.cn: 我最近迷上了爵士乐。

senses.def: to become familiar with sth; to learn sth

ex.en: I haven't really got into my new job yet.
ex.cn: 我还未真正熟悉我的新工作。

senses.def: to reach a particular state or condition; to make sb reach a particular state or condition

ex.en: He got into trouble with the police while he was still at school.
ex.cn: 他还在上学时就曾犯事落入警察手里。

ex.en: Three people were rescued from a yacht which got into difficulties.
ex.cn: 从遇险的游艇中营救出了三人。

ex.en: She got herself into a real state (= became very anxious) before the interview.
ex.cn: 她面试前格外地焦虑不安。

senses.def: used especially to tell sb to stop touching you or another person
senses.chn: （尤用于告诉别人）别碰，走远点

ex.en: Get off me, that hurts!
ex.cn: 放开我，好痛哟！

senses.def: to leave a place or start a journey; to help sb do this

ex.en: We got off straight after breakfast.
ex.cn: 我们早饭后就立即动身了。

ex.en: He got the children off to school.
ex.cn: 他打发孩子们上学去了。

senses.def: to fall asleep; to make sb do this

ex.en: I had great difficulty getting off to sleep.
ex.cn: 我很难入睡。

ex.en: They couldn't get the baby off till midnight.
ex.cn: 他们直到半夜才把宝宝哄入睡。

senses.def: to leave work with permission

ex.en: Could you get off (work) early tomorrow?
ex.cn: 你明天可以提早下班吗？

senses.def: to stop discussing a particular subject; to make sb do this

ex.en: Please can we get off the subject of dieting?
ex.cn: 我们别再谈论节食这个话题行吗？

ex.en: I couldn't get him off politics once he had started.
ex.cn: 他一谈起政治我就没法让他停下。

senses.def: to send sth by post/mail

ex.en: I must get these letters off first thing tomorrow.
ex.cn: 我明天首先得把这些信件寄出去。

senses.def: to be excited by sth, especially in a sexual way
senses.chn: 因…而兴奋，因…而激动（尤指性兴奋）

senses.def: to have no or almost no injuries in an accident
senses.chn: （在事故中）幸免于难，并无大恙

ex.en: She was lucky to get off with just a few bruises.
ex.cn: 她幸免于难，只有几处碰伤。

senses.def: to receive no or almost no punishment; to help sb do this

ex.en: He was lucky to get off with a small fine.
ex.cn: 他侥幸逃脱惩罚，交了一小笔罚款就了事。

ex.en: A good lawyer might be able to get you off.
ex.cn: 请位好律师或许能使你脱罪。

senses.def: to have a sexual or romantic experience with sb; to start a sexual relationship with sb
senses.chn: （与某人）发生性关系，谈恋爱，开始性关系

ex.en: Steve got off with Tracey at the party.
ex.cn: 史蒂夫在聚会上就与特蕾西亲热起来。

senses.def: used to talk or ask about how well sb is doing in a particular situation

ex.en: He's getting on very well at school.
ex.cn: 他在学校学得很好。

ex.en: How did you get on at the interview?
ex.cn: 你面试的情况怎么样？

senses.def: to be successful in your career, etc.

ex.en: Parents are always anxious for their children to get on.
ex.cn: 父母总是急切地盼望孩子们事业有成。

ex.en: I don't know how he's going to get on in life.
ex.cn: 我不知道他将如何出人头地。

senses.def: to manage or survive

ex.en: We can get on perfectly well without her.
ex.cn: 没有她我们也能过得很好。

ex.en: I just can't get along without a secretary.
ex.cn: 没有秘书我简直寸步难行。

senses.def: to contact sb by telephone, letter or email
senses.chn: （用电话、书信或电子邮件）与某人联系

ex.en: The heating isn't working; I'll get on to the landlord about it.
ex.cn: 暖气不热，我得与房东联系一下。

senses.def: to become aware of sb's activities, especially when they have been doing sth bad or illegal
senses.chn: 觉察，察觉，识破（某人的不法行为）

ex.en: He had been stealing money from the company for years before they got on to him.
ex.cn: 他一直窃取公司的钱，多年后他们才发觉。

senses.def: to begin to talk about a new subject
senses.chn: 开始讨论，转而谈论（新课题）

ex.en: It's time we got on to the question of costs.
ex.cn: 我们该讨论成本问题了。

senses.def: to have a friendly relationship with sb

ex.en: She's never really got on with her sister.
ex.cn: 她从未与妹妹真正和睦相处过。

ex.en: She and her sister have never really got on.
ex.cn: 她与妹妹一直合不来。

ex.en: We get along just fine together.
ex.cn: 我们相处得还算融洽。

senses.def: used to talk or ask about how well sb is doing a task
senses.chn: （谈及或问及工作情况）进展，进步

ex.en: I'm not getting on very fast with this job.
ex.cn: 我这个工作进展不太快。

senses.def: to continue doing sth, especially after an interruption

ex.en: Be quiet and get on with your work.
ex.cn: 安静下来，继续干你的事。

ex.en: Get on with it! We haven't got all day.
ex.cn: 继续干吧！我们的时间并不多。

senses.def: to become known

ex.en: If this gets out there'll be trouble.
ex.cn: 这事要是被人知道就麻烦了。

senses.def: to produce or publish sth

ex.en: Will we get the book out by the end of the year?
ex.cn: 我们这本书将在年底前出版吗？

senses.def: to say sth with difficulty

ex.en: She managed to get out a few words of thanks.
ex.cn: 她终于勉强说了几句道谢的话。

senses.def: to leave or go out of a place

ex.en: You ought to get out of the house more.
ex.cn: 你应该多到户外去走走。

ex.en: She screamed at me to get out.
ex.cn: 她冲着我大声喊，让我出去。

senses.def: to avoid a responsibility or duty
senses.chn: 逃避，规避，摆脱（责任或义务）

ex.en: We promised we'd go—we can't get out of it now.
ex.cn: 我们答应过要去的，现在我们不能食言。

ex.en: I wish I could get out of going to that meeting.
ex.cn: 但愿我能不去参加那个会。

senses.def: to stop having a particular habit

ex.en: I can't get out of the habit of waking at six in the morning.
ex.cn: 我早上六点钟醒的习惯改不了。

senses.def: to persuade sb to tell or give you sth, especially by force

ex.en: The police finally got a confession out of her.
ex.cn: 警方最终逼迫她招了供。

senses.def: to gain or obtain sth good from sb/sth

ex.en: She seems to get a lot out of life.
ex.cn: 她似乎从生活中获益良多。

ex.en: He always gets the best out of people.
ex.cn: 他总能使人发挥最大的潜力。

senses.def: to deal with or gain control of sth

ex.en: She can't get over her shyness.
ex.cn: 她无法克服羞怯心理。

ex.en: I think the problem can be got over without too much difficulty.
ex.cn: 我认为这个问题不太难解决。

senses.def: to return to your usual state of health, happiness, etc. after an illness, a shock, the end of a relationship, etc.
senses.chn: 从疾病（或震惊、断绝关系等）中恢复常态

ex.en: He was disappointed at not getting the job, but he'll get over it.
ex.cn: 他没得到这份工作非常失望，不过他会想得开的。

senses.def: to stop thinking that you are so important; to stop being so serious
senses.chn: 别自以为是；别太当真了

ex.en: Just get over yourself and stop moaning!
ex.cn: 别太当真了，停止抱怨吧！

ex.en: He needs to grow up a bit and get over himself.
ex.cn: 他需要更成熟一点，不再那么自以为是。

senses.def: to make sth clear to sb
senses.chn: 向（某人）讲清某事；让（某人）明白某事

ex.en: He didn't really get his meaning over to the audience.
ex.cn: 他没能把他的意思清楚传递给观众。

senses.def: to complete sth unpleasant but necessary
senses.chn: 完成，结束（令人不快但免不了的事）

ex.en: I'll be glad to get the exam over and done with.
ex.cn: 考试结束后我就高兴了。

senses.def: to persuade sb to agree or to do what you want, usually by doing nice things for them
senses.chn: （常用讨好卖乖的手段）说服某人同意，哄骗某人依顺，笼络某人

ex.en: She knows how to get round her dad.
ex.cn: 她知道怎样讨她爸爸的欢心。

senses.def: to deal with a problem successfully

ex.en: A clever lawyer might find a way of getting round that clause.
ex.cn: 高明的律师也许能找到绕过那个条款的办法。

senses.def: to find the time to do sth

ex.en: I meant to do the ironing but I didn't get round to it.
ex.cn: 我本想熨衣服的，可就是抽不出时间。

ex.en: I hope to get around to answering your letter next week.
ex.cn: 我希望下周能抽出时间给你回信。

senses.def: to use up a large amount of sth

ex.en: We got through a fortune while we were in New York!
ex.cn: 我们在纽约时花掉了一大笔钱！

senses.def: to manage to do or complete sth

ex.en: Let's start—there's a lot to get through.
ex.cn: 咱们开始吧，有很多事要处理呢。

senses.def: to be successful in an exam, etc.
to help sb to be successful in an exam
senses.chn: 帮助某人顺利通过考试

ex.en: She got all her students through the exam.
ex.cn: 她帮助她所有的学生顺利通过了考试。

senses.def: to be officially accepted; to make sth be officially accepted

ex.en: They got the bill through Congress.
ex.cn: 他们使此议案在国会获得通过。

senses.def: to reach sb

ex.en: Thousands of refugees will die if these supplies don't get through to them.
ex.cn: 如果这些供给品运不到，数以千计的难民就会死去。

senses.def: to make contact with sb by telephone

ex.en: I tried calling you several times but I couldn't get through.
ex.cn: 我试着给你打了几次电话，但都没打通。

senses.def: to reach the next stage of a competition

ex.en: Gulbis has got through to the final.
ex.cn: 古尔比斯已进入决赛。

senses.def: to make sb understand or accept what you say, especially when you are trying to help them
senses.chn: （尤指在努力帮助某人时）使某人理解，使某人接受（所讲的话）

ex.en: I find it impossible to get through to her.
ex.cn: 我发觉根本无法让她听懂。

senses.def: to finish or complete a task
to annoy or affect sb
senses.chn: 使烦恼；使生气；对某人产生影响

ex.en: The pressure of work is beginning to get to him.
ex.cn: 工作的压力使他烦恼起来。

senses.def: to collect people or things in one place

ex.en: I'm trying to get a team together for Saturday.
ex.cn: 我正设法召集一帮人过周六呢。

senses.def: to meet with sb socially or in order to discuss sth

ex.en: We must get together for a drink sometime.
ex.cn: 我们什么时候得聚在一起喝一杯。

ex.en: Management should get together with the union.
ex.cn: 资方应与工会在一起开个会。

senses.def: to stand up after sitting, lying, etc.

ex.en: The class got up when the teacher came in.
ex.cn: 老师进来时全班起立。

ex.en: She was too weak to stand.
ex.cn: 她虚弱得站都站不住。

ex.en: Stand still when I'm talking to you!
ex.cn: 我跟你说话，站着别动！

ex.en: We stood talking for a few minutes.
ex.cn: 我们站着谈了几分钟。

ex.en: He stood and looked out to sea.
ex.cn: 他站着向大海望去。

ex.en: Please don't get up!
ex.cn: 请不要站起来！

senses.def: if the sea or wind gets up, it increases in strength and becomes violent
to get out of bed; to make sb get out of bed

ex.en: He always gets up early.
ex.cn: 他一向起得早。

ex.en: Could you get me up at 6.30 tomorrow?
ex.cn: 明天你 6:30 叫我起床行吗？

senses.def: to dress yourself/sb as sb/sth else

ex.en: She was got up as an Indian princess.
ex.cn: 她被打扮成了印度公主。

senses.def: to arrange or organize sth

ex.en: We're getting up a party for her birthday.
ex.cn: 我们正在筹备她的生日聚会。

senses.def: to reach a particular point

ex.en: We got up to page 72 last lesson.
ex.cn: 我们上一课学到第 72 页。

senses.def: to be busy with sth, especially sth surprising or unpleasant
senses.chn: 忙于，从事（尤指令人吃惊或不快的事）

ex.en: What on earth will he get up to next?
ex.cn: 他下一步究竟要干什么？

ex.en: She's been getting up to her old tricks again!
ex.cn: 她又在故伎重演了！

example.en: Did you get a present for your mother?
example.cn: 给你母亲买礼物了吗？

example.en: Did you get your mother a present?
example.cn: 给你母亲买礼物了吗？

example.en: Quick— go and get a cloth!
example.cn: 快，去拿块布来！

example.en: to get angry/bored/hungry/fat
example.cn: 发怒；生厌；饥饿；发胖

example.en: Don't get your dress dirty!
example.cn: 别把你的连衣裙弄脏了！

example.en: I couldn't get the car to start this morning.
example.cn: 我今天早上没法让这汽车发动起来。

example.en: Can you really get that old car going again?
example.cn: 你真能让那老爷车再跑起来吗？

example.en: The general had to get his troops across the river.
example.cn: 将军必须让部队过河。

example.en: I must go home and get tea for the kids.
example.cn: 我得回家为孩子们准备茶点。

example.en: Nobody gets away with insulting me like that.
example.cn: 任何人那样侮辱我都不会有好果子吃。

example.en: It's time I got down to thinking about that essay.
example.cn: 我该认真思考一下那篇论文了。

example.en: I wish I could get out of going to that meeting.
example.cn: 但愿我能不去参加那个会。

senses.def: to have too high an opinion of yourself
senses.chn: 自以为了不起；自高自大；自视甚高

get a charge out of sth.lemma: get a charge out of sth

senses.def: to get a strong feeling of excitement or pleasure from sth
senses.chn: 从…中得到快感（或快乐、乐趣）

senses.def: to be recognized as being good (originally meaning to be chosen for a football team)
used to tell sb to stop being boring and to do sth more interesting
senses.chn: （让人别再令人厌烦，要做更有趣的事）来点儿有意思的

senses.def: to leave a place

ex.en: It's time we were getting along.
ex.cn: 我们该离开了。

get a monkey off your back.lemma: get a monkey off your back

senses.def: to free yourself of something that causes you worry or difficulty

ex.en: The team have never beaten Germany and they'll be desperate to get that monkey off their backs.
ex.cn: 该队从未打败过德国队，他们太想战胜这个对手，一吐心中的郁闷了。

senses.def: you tell sb to get a move on when you want them to hurry

get a rise out of sb.lemma: get a rise out of sb

senses.def: to make sb react in an angry way by saying sth that you know will annoy them, especially as a joke
to move from place to place or from person to person

ex.en: She gets around with the help of a stick.
ex.cn: 她拄着拐杖四处走动。

ex.en: News soon got around that he had resigned.
ex.cn: 他已辞职的消息很快传开了。

senses.def: to keep criticizing sb
senses.chn: 一再批评，不断指责，老是数落（某人）

ex.en: He's always getting at me.
ex.cn: 他老是责备我。

ex.en: She feels she's being got at.
ex.cn: 她感到自己总是受人数落。

senses.def: to learn or find out sth

ex.en: The truth is sometimes difficult to get at.
ex.cn: 有时真相很难查明。

senses.def: to have a holiday/vacation

ex.en: We're hoping to get away for a few days at Easter.
ex.cn: 我们期待着复活节出去休几天假。

senses.def: used to show that you do not believe or are surprised by what sb has said

ex.en: 'These tickets didn't cost me a thing.' 'Get away!'
ex.cn: “这些票我一分钱也没花。” “胡说！”

senses.def: an escape from a difficult situation, especially after committing a crime

ex.en: to make a quick getaway
ex.cn: 迅速逃跑

ex.en: a getaway car
ex.cn: 逃跑用的汽车

senses.def: a short holiday/vacation; a place that is suitable for a holiday/vacation
senses.chn: 短假；假日休闲地；适合度假的地方

ex.en: a romantic weekend getaway in New York
ex.cn: 在纽约度过的浪漫周末

ex.en: the popular island getaway of Penang
ex.cn: 深受人们喜爱的槟榔屿度假岛

senses.def: to have a short holiday/vacation in a place where you can relax
to do whatever you want without being stopped or punished
senses.chn: 逍遥法外；（做了错事而）安然无事

senses.def: to steal sth and escape with it

ex.en: Thieves got away with computer equipment worth $30 000.
ex.cn: 盗贼偷走了价值 3 万美元的计算机设备。

senses.def: to receive a relatively light punishment
senses.chn: 受到从轻发落（轻微惩罚）

ex.en: He was lucky to get away with only a fine.
ex.cn: 他算是万幸，只被罚款了事。

senses.def: to do sth wrong and not be punished for it

ex.en: Don't be tempted to cheat—you'll never get away with it.
ex.cn: 别想着作弊，作弊者一定会受到严惩。

ex.en: Nobody gets away with insulting me like that.
ex.cn: 任何人那样侮辱我都不会有好果子吃。

senses.def: to manage with less of sth than you might expect to need
senses.chn: 以（比预期少的事物）就能应付

ex.en: After the first month, you should be able to get away with one lesson a week.
ex.cn: 第一个月之后，每周上一次课就可以了。

example.en: Nobody gets away with insulting me like that.
example.cn: 任何人那样侮辱我都不会有好果子吃。

senses.def: to return, especially to your home

ex.en: What time did you get back last night?
ex.cn: 你昨晚什么时候回家的？

ex.en: I waited a long time for him to return.
ex.cn: 我等他回来等了很长时间。

ex.en: Come back and visit again soon!
ex.cn: 请早点儿再回来探访！

ex.en: Do you ever want to go back to China?
ex.cn: 你想过回中国去吗？

ex.en: What time did you get back last night?
ex.cn: 你昨晚什么时候回家的？

ex.en: The weather got so bad that we had to turn back.
ex.cn: 天气变得非常恶劣，我们不得不循原路折回。

senses.def: to do sth bad to sb who has done sth bad to you; to get revenge on sb

ex.en: I'll find a way of getting back at him!
ex.cn: 我会想法报复他的！

senses.def: to become successful again after a period of failure, or to begin functioning normally again
to speak or write to sb again later, especially in order to give a reply
senses.chn: 以后再答复（或回复）某人

ex.en: I'll find out and get back to you.
ex.cn: 我查明之后再答复你。

senses.def: to return to sth

ex.en: Could we get back to the question of funding?
ex.cn: 我们回到资金问题上来好吗？

senses.def: to begin immediately and work quickly

ex.en: There's a lot to be done, so let's get cracking.
ex.cn: 要做的工作很多，咱们马上就干吧。

senses.def: to leave the table after a meal
to start dealing with the matter that needs to be dealt with , or doing the work that needs to be done
senses.chn: 着手处理正事；开始认真工作

senses.def: to begin to do sth; to give serious attention to sth
senses.chn: 开始做某事；开始认真注意（或对待）某事

ex.en: Let's get down to business.
ex.cn: 咱们开始干正事吧。

ex.en: I like to get down to work by 9.
ex.cn: 我喜欢在 9 点之前开始工作。

ex.en: It's time I got down to thinking about that essay.
ex.cn: 我该认真思考一下那篇论文了。

example.en: It's time I got down to thinking about that essay.
