ex.cn: 外国汽车充斥市场。

senses.def: a sticky substance that is a mixture of two proteins and is left when starch is removed from flour, especially wheat flour

ex.en: We sell a range of gluten-free products (= not containing gluten ).
ex.cn: 我们出售各种无谷蛋白产品。

senses.def: the muscles in the buttocks that move the top of the leg
any of the three muscles in each buttock
sticky

ex.en: glutinous rice
ex.cn: 糯米

senses.def: a person who eats too much
senses.chn: 贪吃者；吃得过多的人；饕餮

senses.def: a person who enjoys doing difficult or unpleasant tasks
the habit of eating and drinking too much
a thick sweet clear liquid made from fats and oils and used in medicines, beauty products and explosives
senses.chn: 甘油，丙三醇（用于药物、美容产品和炸药）

senses.def: a symbol carved out of stone, especially one from an ancient writing system
genetically modified

ex.en: GM foods or 'Frankenstein foods' as they are popularly called
ex.cn: 转基因食品或人们常说的 “弗兰肯斯坦食品”

senses.def: grant-maintained (used in Britain to describe schools that received money from central, not local, government during the 1990s)
senses.chn: （20 世纪 90 年代英国学校）由中央政府出资的，中央政府拨款的

senses.def: Graduate Management Admissions Test (a test taken by graduate students in the US who want to study for a degree in Business)
senses.chn: （美国）企业管理研究生入学考试

senses.def: the abbreviation for 'genetically modified organism' (a plant, etc. that has had its genetic structure changed artificially, so that it will produce more fruit or not be affected by disease)
senses.chn: 遗传修饰生物体，转基因生物（全写为 genetically modified organism，人为改变基因结构以求产量更高或抗病的生物）

senses.def: Greenwich Mean Time (the time at Greenwich in England on the line of 0° longitude, used in the past for calculating time everywhere in the world)
senses.chn: 格林尼治平时，世界时（全写为 Greenwich Mean Time）

senses.def: twisted and rough; covered with hard lumps
senses.chn: 扭曲的；多节瘤的；疙疙瘩瘩的

ex.en: a gnarled oak/branch/trunk
ex.cn: 多节瘤的橡树／树枝／树干

senses.def: bent and twisted because of age or illness
senses.chn: （因年老或疾病）弯曲的，扭曲的

ex.en: gnarled hands
ex.cn: 扭曲的手

senses.def: difficult or dangerous
very good; excellent

ex.en: Wow, man! That's totally gnarly!
ex.cn: 哇，老兄，那真是太好了！

senses.def: to feel very angry and upset about sth, especially because you cannot get what you want
senses.chn: （尤因不获所求而气得）咬牙切齿

ex.en: He'll be gnashing his teeth when he hears that we lost the contract.
ex.cn: 他要是听说我们丢了这份合同，准会气得咬牙切齿。

senses.def: teeth
to feel very angry and upset about sth, especially because you cannot get what you want
senses.chn: （尤因不获所求而气得）咬牙切齿

ex.en: He'll be gnashing his teeth when he hears that we lost the contract.
ex.cn: 他要是听说我们丢了这份合同，准会气得咬牙切齿。

senses.def: a small fly with two wings, that bites
to keep biting sth or chewing it hard, so that it gradually disappears

ex.en: The dog was gnawing a bone.
ex.cn: 那狗在啃骨头。

ex.en: Rats had gnawed through the cable.
ex.cn: 老鼠把电缆咬断了。

ex.en: She gnawed at her fingernails.
ex.cn: 她咬手指甲。

ex.en: Self-doubt began to gnaw away at her confidence.
ex.cn: 对自己的怀疑渐渐吞噬了她的自信心。

senses.def: to make sb feel anxious, frightened or uncomfortable over a long period of time

ex.en: The problem had been gnawing at him for months.
ex.cn: 几个月来这个问题一直折磨着他。

example.en: The dog was gnawing a bone.
example.cn: 那狗在啃骨头。

example.en: Rats had gnawed through the cable.
example.cn: 老鼠把电缆咬断了。

example.en: She gnawed at her fingernails.
example.cn: 她咬手指甲。

example.en: Self-doubt began to gnaw away at her confidence.
example.cn: 对自己的怀疑渐渐吞噬了她的自信心。

senses.def: to make sb feel anxious, frightened or uncomfortable over a long period of time

ex.en: The problem had been gnawing at him for months.
ex.cn: 几个月来这个问题一直折磨着他。

senses.def: making you feel worried over a period of time
senses.chn: （长时间）折磨人的，令人痛苦的，使人苦恼的

ex.en: gnawing doubts
ex.cn: 令人痛苦的疑虑

senses.def: a type of metamorphic rock formed at high pressure and temperature deep in the ground
senses.chn: 片麻岩（地层深处在高压高温下形成的变质岩）

senses.def: an Italian dish consisting of small balls of potato mixed with flour and boiled, usually eaten with a sauce
senses.chn: 意大利团子（用面粉和马铃薯做成）

senses.def: (in stories) a creature like a small man with a pointed hat, who lives under the ground and guards gold and treasure
senses.chn: （神话故事中的）地下宝藏守护神

senses.def: a plastic or stone figure of a gnome, used to decorate a garden
clever and wise but sometimes difficult to understand
senses.chn: 喜用格言的；精辟的；深奥的

senses.def: the abbreviation for 'gross national product' (the total value of all the goods and services produced by a country in one year, including the total income from foreign countries)
senses.chn: 国民生产总值（全写为 gross national product）

senses.def: to move or travel from one place to another

ex.en: She went into her room and shut the door behind her.
ex.cn: 她走进自己的房间，把门关上。

ex.en: He goes to work by bus.
ex.cn: 他乘公共汽车去上班。

ex.en: I have to go to Rome on business.
ex.cn: 我得去罗马出差。

ex.en: She has gone to China (= is now in China or is on her way there).
ex.cn: 她到中国去了。

ex.en: She has been to China (= she went to China and has now returned).
ex.cn: 她去过中国。

ex.en: I think you should go to the doctor's.
ex.cn: 我认为你该去看看医生。

senses.def: to move or travel, especially with sb else, to a particular place or in order to be present at an event
senses.chn: （尤指与某人）去（某处或出席某项活动）

ex.en: Are you going to Dave's party?
ex.cn: 你要去参加戴夫的聚会吗？

ex.en: Who else is going?
ex.cn: 还有谁要去？

ex.en: His dog goes everywhere with him.
ex.cn: 他的狗总是跟着他。

senses.def: to move or travel in a particular way or over a particular distance
senses.chn: 移动，旅行，行走（指方式或距离）

ex.en: He's going too fast.
ex.cn: 他走得太快。

ex.en: We had gone about fifty miles when the car broke down.
ex.cn: 我们行驶了约莫五十英里，汽车突然抛锚了。

senses.def: to move in a particular way or while doing sth else
senses.chn: （以某种方式）移动；在移动中做

ex.en: The car went skidding off the road into a ditch.
ex.cn: 汽车打滑冲出公路跌进沟里。

ex.en: She went sobbing up the stairs.
ex.cn: 她呜咽着上楼去了。

ex.en: She crashed into a waiter and his tray of drinks went flying.
ex.cn: 她一下子撞到侍者身上，弄得他托盘里的饮料四处飞溅。

senses.def: to leave one place in order to reach another

ex.en: I must be going now.
ex.cn: 我现在得走了。

ex.en: They came at six and went at nine.
ex.cn: 他们是六点钟来的，九点钟走的。

ex.en: Has she gone yet?
ex.cn: 她走了吗？

ex.en: He's been gone an hour (= he left an hour ago).
ex.cn: 他离开一小时了。

ex.en: When does the train go?
ex.cn: 火车什么时候开？

senses.def: to leave a place and do sth different

ex.en: to go on a journey/tour/trip/cruise
ex.cn: 去旅行／观光游览／短途旅行／乘船旅游

ex.en: Richard has gone on leave for two weeks.
ex.cn: 理查德休假去了，为期两周。

senses.def: to visit or attend a place for a particular purpose

ex.en: I have to go to hospital for an operation.
ex.cn: 我得去医院动手术。

ex.en: I have to go to the hospital.
ex.cn: 我得到医院去。

ex.en: to go to prison (= to be sent there as punishment for a crime)
ex.cn: 进监狱

ex.en: Do you go to church (= regularly attend church services)?
ex.cn: 你经常上教堂吗？

senses.def: to look at a particular page or website

ex.en: She went on Facebook and changed her relationship status.
ex.cn: 她上脸书更新了她的感情状态。

ex.en: To find out what the terms mean, go to the glossary.
ex.cn: 要了解这些术语的含义，可查看词汇表。

senses.def: to leave a place or travel to a place in order to take part in an activity or a sport
senses.chn: 去参加，去从事（某项活动或运动）

ex.en: to go for a walk/drive/swim/run
ex.cn: 去散步／驱车兜风／游泳／跑步

ex.en: Shall we go for a drink (= at a pub or bar) after work?
ex.cn: 我们下班后去（酒吧）喝一杯好吗？

ex.en: I have to go shopping this afternoon.
ex.cn: 我今天下午得去商店买东西。

ex.en: We're going sailing on Saturday.
ex.cn: 我们打算星期六乘帆船出游。

senses.def: to be sent or passed somewhere

ex.en: I want this memo to go to all managers.
ex.cn: 我想让这份备忘录送交到所有经理手中。

senses.def: to lead or extend from one place to another

ex.en: I want a rope that will go from the top window to the ground.
ex.cn: 我想要一根可从顶楼窗户垂到地面的绳子。

ex.en: Where does this road go?
ex.cn: 这条路通到哪里？

senses.def: to have as a usual or correct position; to be placed
senses.chn: 被放置，被置于，被安放（在通常或合适的位置）

ex.en: This dictionary goes on the top shelf.
ex.cn: 这部词典放在书架最上层。

ex.en: Where do you want the piano to go (= be put)?
ex.cn: 你想把钢琴放在什么地方？

senses.def: used to say that sth does/did not fit into a particular place or space

ex.en: My clothes won't all go in that one suitcase.
ex.cn: 一个手提箱装不下我所有的衣服。

ex.en: He tried to push his hand through the gap but it wouldn't go.
ex.cn: 他试着把手伸进豁口，可就是伸不进去。

senses.def: if a number will go into another number, it is contained in that number an exact number of times

ex.en: 3 into 12 goes 4 times.
7 into 15 won't go.
ex.cn: 7 除 15 除不尽。

ex.en: 7 into 15 doesn't go.
ex.cn: 7 除 15 除不尽。

ex.en: 7 won't go into 15.
ex.cn: 7 除不尽 15。

senses.def: used to talk about how well or badly sth makes progress or succeeds

ex.en: 'How did your interview go?' 'It went very well, thank you.'
ex.cn: “你面试的情况如何？” “非常顺利，谢谢。”

ex.en: Did everything go smoothly?
ex.cn: 一切进行得都顺利吗？

ex.en: How's it going (= is your life enjoyable, successful, etc. at the moment)?
ex.cn: 近况可好？

ex.en: The way things are going the company will be bankrupt by the end of the year.
ex.cn: 从事态发展的情况看，到年底公司就得破产。

senses.def: used in many expressions to show that sb/sth has reached a particular state/is no longer in a particular state
senses.chn: 进入…状态；处于…状况；脱离…状态

ex.en: She went to sleep.
ex.cn: 她睡着了。

ex.en: That colour has gone out of fashion.
ex.cn: 那种颜色已不时兴了。

senses.def: to become different in a particular way, especially a bad way
senses.chn: 变成，变为，变得（尤指朝坏的方面）

ex.en: to go bald/blind/mad/bankrupt, etc.
ex.cn: 谢顶、失明、发疯、破产等

ex.en: Her hair is going grey.
ex.cn: 她的头发日渐花白。

ex.en: This milk has gone sour.
ex.cn: 这牛奶馊了。

ex.en: The children went wild with excitement.
ex.cn: 孩子们欣喜若狂。

ex.en: The sun was shining and the sky was blue.
ex.cn: 阳光灿烂，天空一片蓝。

ex.en: Moonlight gleamed on the water.
ex.cn: 月光照在水面上泛起粼粼波光。

senses.def: to live or move around in a particular state
senses.chn: （在某种状态下）生活，过活，移动

ex.en: to go naked/barefoot
ex.cn: 光着身子；赤着脚

ex.en: She cannot bear the thought of children going hungry.
ex.cn: 想到孩子们挨饿她就受不了。

senses.def: to not be noticed, reported, etc.

ex.en: Police are worried that many crimes go unreported.
ex.cn: 警方感到不安的是，许多罪行发生后无人报案。

senses.def: used to talk about what tune or words a song or poem has or what happens in a story
senses.chn: （歌曲）唱道；（诗歌）写道；（歌词或故事）内容是

ex.en: How does that song go?
ex.cn: 那首歌怎么唱？

ex.en: I forget how the next line goes.
ex.cn: 我忘记下一句台词怎么说了。

ex.en: The story goes that she's been married five times.
ex.cn: 据传她结过五次婚。

senses.def: to make a particular sound or movement
senses.chn: 发出（某种声音）；做（某种动作）

ex.en: The gun went 'bang'.
ex.cn: 枪 “砰” 的一声响了。

ex.en: She went like this with her hand.
ex.cn: 她用手这样比画着。

senses.def: to be sounded as a signal or warning

ex.en: The whistle went for the end of the game.
ex.cn: 比赛结束的哨声响了。

senses.def: to say

ex.en: I asked 'How much?' and he goes, 'Fifty' and I go, 'Fifty? You must be joking!'
ex.cn: 我问：“多少钱？” 他回答说：“五十。” 我又说：“五十？你是在开玩笑吧！”

senses.def: to start an activity

ex.en: I'll say 'One, two, three, go!' as a signal for you to start.
ex.cn: 我喊 “一、二、三，开始！” 作为你开始的信号。

ex.en: As soon as he gets here we're ready to go.
ex.cn: 他一到我们就可以开始。

senses.def: if a machine goes, it works

ex.en: This clock doesn't go.
ex.cn: 这钟不走了。

senses.def: to stop existing; to be lost or stolen
senses.chn: 不复存在；不见了；丢失；失窃

ex.en: Has your headache gone yet?
ex.cn: 你还头痛吗？

ex.en: I left my bike outside the library and when I came out again it had gone.
ex.cn: 我把自行车放在图书馆外面，出来时它就不翼而飞了。

senses.def: used to talk about wanting to get rid of sb/sth
senses.chn: （必须或可以）辞掉（或扔掉、废弃）

ex.en: The old sofa will have to go.
ex.cn: 那旧沙发该扔掉了。

ex.en: He's useless—he'll have to go.
ex.cn: 他毫无用处，得辞掉他。

senses.def: to get worse; to become damaged or stop working correctly

ex.en: Her sight is beginning to go.
ex.cn: 她的视力开始下降。

ex.en: His mind is going (= he is losing his mental powers).
ex.cn: 他心智日衰。

ex.en: I was driving home when my brakes went.
ex.cn: 我正开车回家，突然刹车失灵了。

senses.def: to die. People say 'go' to avoid saying 'die'.
senses.chn: 走（委婉说法，与 die 同义）

ex.en: You can't take your money with you when you go.
ex.cn: 你不可能把钱带进棺材。

senses.def: when money goes, it is spent or used for sth

ex.en: I don't know where the money goes!
ex.cn: 我不知道钱都花到什么地方去了！

ex.en: Most of my salary goes on the rent.
ex.cn: 我大部分工资都花在房租上了。

ex.en: The money will go to finance a new community centre.
ex.cn: 这笔钱将用于新的社区活动中心。

senses.def: to be sold

ex.en: We won't let the house go for less than $200 000.
ex.cn: 这房子低于 20 万美元我们是不会卖的。

ex.en: There was usually some bread going cheap (= being sold cheaply) at the end of the day.
ex.cn: 在收市前常常有些面包降价出售。

senses.def: to be willing to pay a particular amount of money for sth

ex.en: He's offered £3 000 for the car and I don't think he'll go any higher.
ex.cn: 他出价 3 000 英镑买这辆汽车，我看他不会愿意再多付了。

ex.en: I'll go to $1 000 but that's my limit.
ex.cn: 我愿意出 1 000 美元，这可是最大限度了。

senses.def: to help; to play a part in doing sth

ex.en: This all goes to prove my theory.
ex.cn: 这一切都有助于证明我的说法是对的。

ex.en: It (= what has just happened) just goes to show you can't always tell how people are going to react.
ex.cn: 这正好说明你不可能总是知道人们会如何反应。

senses.def: to be available
senses.chn: 可得到；可买到；现成可用

ex.en: There just aren't any jobs going in this area.
ex.cn: 此地几乎没有工作可找。

senses.def: used to talk about how quickly or slowly time seems to pass

ex.en: Hasn't the time gone quickly?
ex.cn: 时光过得真快，是不是？

ex.en: Half an hour went past while we were sitting there.
ex.cn: 我们坐在那里，半个小时就这样过去了。

senses.def: to use a toilet

ex.en: Do you need to go, Billy?
ex.cn: 你要上厕所吗，比利？

senses.def: anything that sb says or does is accepted or allowed, however shocking or unusual it may be
senses.chn: 无奇不有；什么事都不新鲜

ex.en: Almost anything goes these days.
ex.cn: 这个年月几乎是无奇不有。

senses.def: in comparison with the average person, thing, etc.
senses.chn: 和一般人（或事物等）相比

ex.en: As teachers go, he's not bad.
ex.cn: 和一般教师相比，他是不错的。

senses.def: to be nearly a particular age, time or number
senses.chn: 接近（或将近、快到）某一年龄（或时间、数字）

ex.en: It was going on (for) midnight.
ex.cn: 快半夜了。

senses.def: used to show what sb intends to do in the future

ex.en: We're going to buy a house when we've saved enough money.
ex.cn: 我们打算攒够钱后买所房子。

senses.def: used to show that sth is likely to happen very soon or in the future
senses.chn: 快要发生某事；某事将要发生

ex.en: I think I'm going to faint.
ex.cn: 我看我快昏倒了。

ex.en: If the drought continues there's going to be a famine.
ex.cn: 如果旱灾继续下去很可能要发生饥荒。

senses.def: used to tell or warn sb not to do sth

ex.en: Don't go getting yourself into trouble.
ex.cn: 别惹麻烦。

senses.def: something that is enough for a short time
senses.chn: 暂且够用；足以应付一时

ex.en: £50 should be enough to be going on with.
ex.cn: 50 英镑该够应付一时半会儿的了。

senses.def: to make a very great effort to get sth or do sth
senses.chn: 竭力获取某物；全力以赴做某事；鼓足干劲做某事

senses.def: used to show that you are angry or annoyed that sb has done sth stupid
senses.chn: （对某人做了蠢事感到愤怒或烦恼）竟然干出某事，居然干出某事

ex.en: Trust him to go and mess things up!
ex.cn: 就知道他会把事情弄得一团糟！

ex.en: Why did you have to go and upset your mother like that?
ex.cn: 你干吗非得让你母亲那样伤心呢？

ex.en: You've really gone and done it (= done sth very stupid) now!
ex.cn: 你竟然干出这样的事来！

senses.def: to suddenly become very angry
used to express the fact that you do not believe sth, or that you disapprove of sth
senses.chn: （表示不相信或不赞同）去你的，我才不信呢

senses.def: (to have) many/not many advantages
senses.chn: 有（或没有）很多有利条件

ex.en: You're young, intelligent, attractive—you have a lot going for you!
ex.cn: 你年轻、聪明、漂亮，有利条件可多啦！

senses.def: not possible or allowed

ex.en: If the bank won't lend us the money it's no go, I'm afraid.
ex.cn: 如果银行不愿贷款给我们，这恐怕就行不通了。

senses.def: used to say that you do not want to talk about sth in any more detail because you do not even want to think about it
senses.chn: 不想细谈；甚至不愿想起

ex.en: Don't ask me to choose. I don't want to go there.
ex.cn: 别让我挑选。我连想都不愿想。

ex.en: 'There was a problem with his parents, wasn't there?' 'Don't even go there!'
ex.cn: “他的父母有问题，是不是？” “别往下说了！”

senses.def: remaining; still left

ex.en: I only have one exam to go.
ex.cn: 我只剩一门考试了。

senses.def: if you buy cooked food to go in a restaurant or shop/store, you buy it to take away and eat somewhere else
senses.chn: （食品）外卖的；带出餐馆（或商店）吃的

ex.en: Two pizzas to go.
ex.cn: 来两份比萨饼，带走。

senses.def: the way sb behaves towards other people will affect the way those people behave towards them in the future
senses.chn: 你怎么待人，人就怎么待你

senses.def: something that is not fashionable now will become fashionable again in the future
senses.chn: 现在过时的还会再时兴起来

senses.def: used to ask what action sb should take, especially in order to improve the difficult situation that they are in
senses.chn: （尤指为了改变困境而询问）下一步该怎么办，往下怎么做呢

senses.def: used by a soldier who is guarding a place to order sb to say who they are
senses.chn: （哨兵喝问对方身份用语）谁，什么人

ex.en: Halt, who goes there?
ex.cn: 站住，什么人？

senses.def: to continue to do sth; to keep busy with sth

ex.en: Despite the threat of war, people went about their business as usual.
ex.cn: 虽然有可能发生战争，人们照常忙着自己的事。

senses.def: to start working on sth
senses.chn: 着手做某事；开始做某事

ex.en: You're not going about the job in the right way.
ex.cn: 你做这事的方法不对。

ex.en: How should I go about finding a job?
ex.cn: 我该怎样着手找工作呢？

senses.def: to chase or follow sb
senses.chn: 追赶某人；跟在某人后面

ex.en: He went after the burglars.
ex.cn: 他追赶那些窃贼。

ex.en: She left the room in tears so I went after her.
ex.cn: 她流着泪离开了房间，于是我跟着追了出去。

senses.def: to try to get sb/sth
senses.chn: 追求某人；谋求某事（或某物）

ex.en: We're both going after the same job.
ex.cn: 我们俩都在谋求同一份工作。

senses.def: to not be in sb's favour or not to their advantage
senses.chn: 对某人不利；不利于某人

ex.en: The jury's verdict went against him.
ex.cn: 陪审团的裁定对他不利。

senses.def: to resist or oppose sb/sth
senses.chn: 反抗（或反对）某人（或某事）；与…相背

ex.en: He would not go against his parents' wishes.
ex.cn: 他不会违背父母的意愿。

senses.def: to be opposed to sth; to not fit or agree with sth

ex.en: Paying for hospital treatment goes against her principles.
ex.cn: 拿钱到医院治病有违她的原则。

ex.en: His thinking goes against all logic.
ex.cn: 他的想法完全不合情理。

senses.def: to travel in front of other people in your group and arrive before them

ex.en: I'll go ahead and tell them you're on the way.
ex.cn: 我要先走一步，告诉他们你在路上。

senses.def: to happen; to be done

ex.en: The building of the new bridge will go ahead as planned.
ex.cn: 新桥的修建将按计划进行。

senses.def: to begin to do sth, especially when sb has given permission or has expressed doubts or opposition
senses.chn: （尤指经某人允许，或有人表示怀疑或反对后）开始做，着手干

ex.en: 'May I start now?' 'Yes, go ahead.'
ex.cn: “我现在可以开始了吗？” “可以，开始吧。”

ex.en: The government intends to go ahead with its tax cutting plans.
ex.cn: 政府拟开始实施减税计划。

senses.def: to continue with an activity

ex.en: He made up the story as he went along.
ex.cn: 这个故事是他现编现讲的。

senses.def: to make progress; to develop

ex.en: Things are going along nicely.
ex.cn: 情况进展良好。

senses.def: to agree with sb/sth
senses.chn: 和某人观点一致；赞同某事

ex.en: I don't go along with her views on private medicine.
ex.cn: 在自费医疗的问题上，我不敢苟同她的观点。

ex.en: He agreed to let me go early.
ex.cn: 他容许我早走。

ex.en: They accepted the court's decision.
ex.cn: 他们接受法院的判决。

ex.en: The committee unanimously approved the plan.
ex.cn: 委员会一致通过了计划。

ex.en: She just goes along with everything he suggests.
ex.cn: 他的一切建议她都赞同。

ex.en: She finally consented to answer our questions.
ex.cn: 她最终同意回答我们的问题。

senses.def: to spin or turn

ex.en: to go round in a circle
ex.cn: 转圈

senses.def: to be enough for everyone to have one or some
senses.chn: 足够分给每个人；够每人一份

ex.en: There aren't enough chairs to go around.
ex.cn: 椅子不够坐。

senses.def: to often be in a particular state or behave in a particular way
senses.chn: 习惯于（某种状态或行动方式）

ex.en: She often goes around barefoot.
ex.cn: 她常常光着脚。

ex.en: It's unprofessional to go round criticizing your colleagues.
ex.cn: 总是指责同事，这不符合职业道德。

senses.def: to spread from person to person

ex.en: There's a rumour going around that they're having an affair.
ex.cn: 谣传他们之间关系暧昧。

senses.def: to visit sb or a place that is near
senses.chn: 拜访（某人）；访问，参观（附近某处）

ex.en: I went round to the post office.
ex.cn: 我到邮局去了一趟。

ex.en: I'm going around to my sister's (= her house) later.
ex.cn: 我打算稍后到姐姐家去看看。

senses.def: to attack sb

ex.en: They went at each other furiously.
ex.cn: 他们相互猛烈攻击。

senses.def: to make great efforts to do sth; to work hard at sth

ex.en: They went at the job as if their lives depended on it.
ex.cn: 他们干起活来好像性命攸关似的。

senses.def: to leave a person or place

ex.en: Just go away!
ex.cn: 走开！

ex.en: Go away and think about it, then let me know.
ex.cn: 到一边去想一想，然后再告诉我。

senses.def: to leave home for a period of time, especially for a holiday/vacation

ex.en: They've gone away for a few days.
ex.cn: 他们已外出几天了。

ex.en: I'm going away on business.
ex.cn: 我要出趟差。

senses.def: to disappear

ex.en: The smell still hasn't gone away.
ex.cn: 气味还没散尽。

senses.def: if two people go back a period of time (usually a long time), they have known each other for that time

ex.en: Dave and I go back twenty years.
ex.cn: 我和戴夫相识有二十年了。

senses.def: to return to a place

ex.en: She doesn't want to go back to her husband (= to live with him again).
ex.cn: 她不想回到丈夫的身边了。

ex.en: This toaster will have to go back (= be taken back to the shop/store where it was bought) —it's faulty.
ex.cn: 这烤面包机得退回去，它有毛病。

ex.en: Of course we want to go back some day—it's our country, our real home.
ex.cn: 我们当然希望有一天能回去，那是我们的祖国，我们真正的家。

ex.en: I waited a long time for him to return.
ex.cn: 我等他回来等了很长时间。

ex.en: Come back and visit again soon!
ex.cn: 请早点儿再回来探访！

ex.en: Do you ever want to go back to China?
ex.cn: 你想过回中国去吗？

senses.def: to consider sth that happened or was said at an earlier time
senses.chn: 回忆起；回到（原来的话题）

ex.en: Can I go back to what you said at the beginning of the meeting?
ex.cn: 我想回到你在会议开始时所提的话题，行吗？

ex.en: Once you have made this decision, there will be no going back (= you will not be able to change your mind).
ex.cn: 你一旦作出这个决定就不能改变。

senses.def: to have existed since a particular time or for a particular period

ex.en: Their family goes back to the time of the Pilgrim Fathers.
ex.cn: 他们家族的渊源可追溯到清教徒前辈移民时代。

senses.def: to fail to keep a promise; to change your mind about sth

ex.en: He never goes back on his word (= never fails to do what he has said he will do).
ex.cn: 他从不食言。

senses.def: to start doing sth again that you had stopped doing

ex.en: The kids go back to school next week.
ex.cn: 孩子们下周开学。

ex.en: She's decided to go back to teaching.
ex.cn: 她已决定重新执教。

senses.def: to exist or happen in an earlier time
senses.chn: 居先；先前存在；以往发生

ex.en: The present crisis is worse than any that have gone before.
ex.cn: 目前的危机比以往任何一次危机都严重。

senses.def: to be presented to sb/sth for discussion, decision or judgement
senses.chn: 提交给…讨论（或决定、裁决）

ex.en: My application goes before the planning committee next week.
ex.cn: 我的申请下周提交计划委员会审批。

senses.def: to be more than sth

ex.en: This year's sales figures go beyond all our expectations (= are much better than we thought they would be).
ex.cn: 今年的销售额大大超过我们的预期。

senses.def: to pass

ex.en: Things will get easier as time goes by.
ex.cn: 随着时间的推移情况会有所改善。

ex.en: The weeks went slowly by.
ex.cn: 时间一周周慢慢地过去了。

senses.def: to be guided by sth; to form an opinion from sth
senses.chn: 遵循（或依照）某事；以某事来判断

ex.en: That's a good rule to go by.
ex.cn: 那是要遵守的好规则。

ex.en: If past experience is anything to go by, they'll be late.
ex.cn: 凭以往的经验看，他们会迟到的。

senses.def: to fall to the ground

ex.en: She tripped and went down with a bump.
ex.cn: 她绊了一下，重重地倒在地上。

senses.def: if a ship, etc. goes down, it disappears below the water
when the sun or moon goes down, it disappears below the horizon
if food or drink will/will not go down, it is easy/difficult to swallow
senses.chn: （食物、饮料）被吞下，被咽下，被喝下

ex.en: A glass of wine would go down very nicely (= I would very much like one).
ex.cn: 喝一杯葡萄酒就太痛快了。

senses.def: if the price of sth, the temperature, etc. goes down, it becomes lower

ex.en: The price of oil is going down.
ex.cn: 油价正在下跌。

ex.en: Oil is going down in price.
ex.cn: 油价正在下跌。

senses.def: to get worse in quality

ex.en: The neighbourhood has gone down a lot recently.
ex.cn: 近来这一带地方已远不如从前了。

senses.def: to stop working temporarily

ex.en: The system is going down in ten minutes.
ex.cn: 这个系统十分钟后要暂停运行。

senses.def: to happen

ex.en: You really don't know what's going down?
ex.cn: 你真的不知道发生了什么事？

senses.def: to leave a university, especially Oxford or Cambridge, at the end of a term or after finishing your studies
senses.chn: （大学学期结束或毕业时）离校（尤指牛津或剑桥）

senses.def: to be written in sth; to be recorded or remembered in sth

ex.en: It all goes down (= she writes it all) in her notebook.
ex.cn: 那些东西全记在她的笔记本上。

ex.en: He will go down in history as a great statesman.
ex.cn: 他将作为伟大的政治家名垂青史。

senses.def: to perform oral sex on sb (= to use the mouth to give sb sexual pleasure)
to be defeated by sb, especially in a game or competition

ex.en: Italy went down to Brazil by three goals to one.
ex.cn: 意大利队以一比三输给了巴西队。

senses.def: to go from one place to another, especially further south or from a city or large town to a smaller place
senses.chn: （从一处）到（另一处）（尤指南下或从城市、大城镇到小地方）

ex.en: They've gone down to Brighton for a couple of days.
ex.cn: 他们已南下到布赖顿去待几天。

senses.def: to be received in a particular way by sb
senses.chn: 受到（某人的…）对待；被接受

ex.en: The suggestion didn't go down very well with her boss.
ex.cn: 她的老板对这个建议不太感兴趣。

senses.def: to become ill/sick with sth

ex.en: Our youngest boy has gone down with chickenpox.
ex.cn: 我们的小儿子染上了水痘。

senses.def: to attack sb
senses.chn: 袭击某人；抨击（或攻击）某人

ex.en: She went for him with a knife.
ex.cn: 她手持尖刀向他刺去。

senses.def: to apply to sb/sth

ex.en: What I said about Peter goes for you, too.
ex.cn: 我说的关于彼得的话也适用于你。

ex.en: They have a high level of unemployment—but the same goes for many other countries.
ex.cn: 他们的失业率很高，不过，其他许多国家也是如此。

senses.def: to go to a place and bring sb/sth back
senses.chn: 去带回某人；去取回某物

ex.en: She's gone for some milk.
ex.cn: 她买牛奶去了。

senses.def: to be attracted by sb/sth; to like or prefer sb/sth
senses.chn: 被…所吸引；（更）喜欢某人（或某事物）

ex.en: She goes for tall slim men.
ex.cn: 她喜欢瘦高个子的男人。

ex.en: I don't really go for modern art.
ex.cn: 我并不是很喜欢现代艺术。

senses.def: to choose sth

ex.en: I think I'll go for the fruit salad.
ex.cn: 我想要水果色拉。

ex.en: You choose—I can't decide.
ex.cn: 你来选吧，我拿不定主意。

ex.en: He was selected for the team.
ex.cn: 他已入选进队了。

ex.en: a randomly selected sample of 23 schools
ex.cn: 随机抽选的 23 所学校

ex.en: She picked the best cake for herself.
ex.cn: 她为自己挑了一块最好的蛋糕。

ex.en: We're still trying to decide on a venue.
ex.cn: 我们仍在设法选定一个活动地点。

senses.def: to put a lot of effort into sth, so that you get or achieve sth

ex.en: Go for it, John! You know you can beat him.
ex.cn: 努力争取吧，约翰！你知道你是可以打败他的。

ex.en: It sounds a great idea. Go for it!
ex.cn: 这听起来是个极好的主意。努力去实现吧！

senses.def: to enter a room, house, etc.

ex.en: Let's go in, it's getting cold.
ex.cn: 我们进屋去吧，天冷了。

senses.def: if the sun or moon goes in, it disappears behind a cloud
to take an exam or enter a competition

ex.en: She's going in for the Cambridge First Certificate.
ex.cn: 她打算参加剑桥初级证书考试。

senses.def: to have sth as an interest or a hobby

ex.en: She doesn't go in for team sports.
ex.cn: 她不喜欢团体运动。

senses.def: to join sb in starting a business
senses.chn: 与某人合伙；与某人联合办企业

ex.en: My brothers are opening a garage and they want me to go in with them.
ex.cn: 我的几个兄弟要开办一个汽车修理厂，想让我与他们合伙干。

senses.def: to hit sth violently

ex.en: The car skidded and went into a tree.
ex.cn: 汽车打滑，猛地撞到树上。

senses.def: to start moving in a particular way

ex.en: The plane went into a nosedive.
ex.cn: 飞机开始俯冲。

senses.def: to join an organization, especially in order to have a career in it
senses.chn: 加入某组织；从事某职业

ex.en: to go into the Army/the Church/Parliament
ex.cn: 参军；加入教会；当议会议员

ex.en: to go into teaching
ex.cn: 执教

senses.def: to begin to do sth or behave in a particular way
senses.chn: （以某种方式）开始做某事；开始某种表现

ex.en: He went into a long explanation of the affair.
ex.cn: 他开始长篇大论地解释起那件事来。

senses.def: to examine sth carefully

ex.en: We need to go into the question of costs.
ex.cn: 我们需要研究一下费用问题。

senses.def: to be spent on sth or used to do sth

ex.en: More government money needs to go into the project.
ex.cn: 政府需对此工程投入更多的资金。

ex.en: Years of work went into researching the book.
ex.cn: 多年的工夫全花在对这本书的研究上了。

senses.def: to leave a place, especially in order to do sth

ex.en: She went off to get a drink.
ex.cn: 她拿饮料去了。

senses.def: to be fired; to explode

ex.en: The gun went off by accident.
ex.cn: 枪走火了。

ex.en: The bomb went off in a crowded street.
ex.cn: 炸弹在挤满人群的大街上爆炸了。

ex.en: The jet smashed into a hillside and exploded.
ex.cn: 喷气式飞机撞上山坡爆炸了。

ex.en: The bomb was exploded under controlled conditions.
ex.cn: 对炸弹实施了可控引爆。

ex.en: A police officer was killed when his car blew up.
ex.cn: 一名警员在其汽车爆炸时遇难。

ex.en: The bomb went off in a crowded street.
ex.cn: 炸弹在挤满人的大街上爆炸了。

senses.def: if an alarm, etc. goes off, it makes a sudden loud noise
if a light, the electricity, etc. goes off, it stops working

ex.en: Suddenly the lights went off.
ex.cn: 灯突然熄灭了。

ex.en: The heating goes off at night.
ex.cn: 暖气夜间停止供热。

senses.def: to fall asleep

ex.en: Hasn't the baby gone off yet?
ex.cn: 孩子还没睡着吗？

senses.def: if food or drink goes off, it becomes bad and not fit to eat or drink
to get worse in quality

ex.en: Her books have gone off in recent years.
ex.cn: 她近年写的书质量下降了。

senses.def: to happen in a particular way

ex.en: The meeting went off well.
ex.cn: 会议进行得很好。

senses.def: to suddenly become angry with sb
to stop liking sb/sth or lose interest in them
senses.chn: 不再喜欢某人（或某事物）；失去对…的兴趣

ex.en: Jane seems to be going off Paul.
ex.cn: 简好像不再喜欢保罗了。

ex.en: I've gone off beer.
ex.cn: 我对啤酒已不感兴趣。

senses.def: to leave your husband, wife, partner, etc. in order to have a relationship with sb else
senses.chn: （抛弃原有伴侣等）另寻新欢与（另外的某人）相好；与某人私奔

ex.en: He went off with his best friend's wife.
ex.cn: 他和最要好的朋友的妻子走了。

senses.def: to take away from a place sth that does not belong to you

ex.en: He went off with $10 000 of the company's money.
ex.cn: 他卷走了公司 1 万美元。

senses.def: when a performer goes on, they begin their performance

ex.en: She doesn't go on until Act 2.
ex.cn: 她要到第 2 幕才出场。

senses.def: to join a team as a substitute during a game
senses.chn: （比赛中）以替补队员身份上场

ex.en: Walcott went on in place of Rooney just before half-time.
ex.cn: 就在上半场结束前沃尔科特上场替下了鲁尼。

senses.def: when a light, the electricity, etc. goes on, it starts to work

ex.en: Suddenly all the lights went on.
ex.cn: 突然所有的灯都亮了。

senses.def: to pass

ex.en: She became more and more talkative as the evening went on.
ex.cn: 夜渐深，她的话越来越多。

senses.def: to happen

ex.en: What's going on here?
ex.cn: 这儿出了什么事？

senses.def: if a situation goes on, it continues without changing

ex.en: This cannot be allowed to go on.
ex.cn: 决不允许这种情况继续下去。

ex.en: How much longer will this hot weather go on for?
ex.cn: 这样炎热的天气还会持续多久？

ex.en: We can't go on like this —we seem to be always arguing.
ex.cn: 我们不能这样继续下去，我们似乎老是争吵不休。

senses.def: to continue speaking, often after a short pause

ex.en: She hesitated for a moment and then went on.
ex.cn: 她犹豫了一会儿，然后继续往下说。

ex.en: 'You know,' he went on, 'I think my brother could help you.'
ex.cn: “嗯，” 他接着说，“我想我哥哥可以帮助你。”

senses.def: used to encourage sb to do sth

ex.en: Go on! Have another drink!
ex.cn: 来吧！再喝一杯！

ex.en: Go on—jump!
ex.cn: 来呀，跳吧！

senses.def: to travel in front of sb else

ex.en: You go on ahead—I'll catch you up in a few minutes.
ex.cn: 你先走，我一会儿就赶上来。

senses.def: to base an opinion or a judgement on sth

ex.en: The police don't have much to go on.
ex.cn: 警方没多少依据。

senses.def: to talk about sb/sth for a long time, especially in a boring or complaining way

ex.en: He went on and on about how poor he was.
ex.cn: 他没完没了地哭穷。

ex.en: She does go on sometimes!
ex.cn: 她有时就是唠叨个没完！

senses.def: to complain to sb about their behaviour, work, etc.

ex.en: She goes on at him continually.
ex.cn: 她老是责备他。

senses.def: to continue an activity, especially after a pause or break
senses.chn: （尤指停顿或中断之后）继续做（某事）

ex.en: That's enough for now—let's go on with it tomorrow.
ex.cn: 现在就到这里，咱们明天再继续吧。

senses.def: to continue an activity without stopping

ex.en: He said nothing but just went on working.
ex.cn: 他什么都不说，只是不停地干活。

senses.def: to pass from one item to the next
senses.chn: 进而转入另外一件事；接着开始另一个项目

ex.en: Let's go on to the next item on the agenda.
ex.cn: 咱们接着进行下一项议程吧。

senses.def: to do sth after completing sth else

ex.en: The book goes on to describe his experiences in the army.
ex.cn: 本书继而描述了他在部队的经历。

senses.def: to leave your house to go to a social event
senses.chn: 出门参加社交活动；外出交际；外出娱乐

ex.en: She goes out a lot.
ex.cn: 她经常外出参加社交活动。

ex.en: He goes out drinking most evenings.
ex.cn: 他晚上多半在外喝酒。

senses.def: when the tide goes out, it moves away from the land
to be sent

ex.en: Have the invitations gone out yet?
ex.cn: 请柬发出去了吗？

senses.def: when a radio or television programme goes out, it is broadcast
when news or information goes out, it is announced or published

ex.en: Word went out that the director had resigned.
ex.cn: 局长已经辞职的消息公开了。

senses.def: if a fire or light goes out, it stops burning or shining
to fail to reach the next stage of a competition, etc.

ex.en: She went out of the tournament in the first round.
ex.cn: 她在锦标赛的第一轮比赛中就被淘汰了。

senses.def: to be no longer fashionable or generally used

ex.en: Those skirts went out years ago.
ex.cn: 那些裙子多年前就不时兴了。

senses.def: to be no longer present in sb/sth; to disappear from sb/sth
senses.chn: 在…中不复存在；从…中消失

ex.en: All the fight seemed to go out of him.
ex.cn: 他身上的所有斗志似乎都已丧失殆尽。

senses.def: if your thoughts, etc. go out to sb, you think about them in a kind way and hope that the difficult situation that they are in will get better
senses.chn: 对某人产生同情（及寄予良好的祝愿）

senses.def: to spend time with sb and have a romantic or sexual relationship with them
senses.chn: 与某人谈恋爱（或有性关系）

ex.en: Tom has been going out with Lucy for six weeks.
ex.cn: 汤姆与露西相恋六周了。

ex.en: How long have Tom and Lucy been going out together?
ex.cn: 汤姆和露西相恋多久了？

senses.def: to examine or check sth carefully
senses.chn: 仔细检查（或审查、查阅）某事

ex.en: Go over your work before you hand it in.
ex.cn: 把作业仔细检查后再交。

ex.en: Check your work before handing it in.
ex.cn: 交作业前先检查一遍。

ex.en: The goods were examined for damage on arrival.
ex.cn: 货物到达时已检查是否有破损。

ex.en: Make sure you inspect the goods before signing for them.
ex.cn: 要确保在签收货物之前进行检验。

ex.en: The Tourist Board inspects all recommended hotels at least once a year.
ex.cn: 旅游局至少每年视察一次所有举荐的旅馆。

ex.en: The surveyor examined the walls for signs of damp.
ex.cn: 房屋鉴定人检查了墙壁，看是否有水渍。

senses.def: to study sth carefully, especially by repeating it

ex.en: He went over the events of the day in his mind (= thought about them carefully).
ex.cn: 他心里反复琢磨白天发生的事。

senses.def: to move from one place to another, especially when this means crossing sth such as a room, town or city

ex.en: He went over and shook hands with his guests.
ex.cn: 他走过去与客人们握手。

ex.en: Many Irish people went over to America during the famine.
ex.cn: 许多爱尔兰人在饥荒时期迁徙到美国。

senses.def: to change to a different person or place for the next part of a broadcast
senses.chn: 切换到另一人物（或地点）

ex.en: We are now going over to the news desk for an important announcement.
ex.cn: 我们现在转换到新闻部宣布一则重要消息。

senses.def: to change from one side, opinion, habit, etc. to another
senses.chn: 转向另一立场（或见解、习惯等）

ex.en: Two Conservative MPs have gone over to the Liberal Democrats.
ex.cn: 两名保守党议员已转向自由民主党人一边。

senses.def: to be received in a particular way by sb

ex.en: The news of her promotion went over well with her colleagues.
ex.cn: 她晋升的消息一传开，同事都为她高兴。

senses.def: if a law, contract, etc. goes through, it is officially accepted or completed
senses.chn: （法律、合同等正式）通过，接受，达成

ex.en: The deal did not go through.
ex.cn: 这笔交易未谈成。

senses.def: to look at or examine sth carefully, especially in order to find sth
senses.chn: 仔细察看某事物；检查某事物；审查某事物

ex.en: I always start the day by going through my email.
ex.cn: 我每天第一件事就是看电子邮件。

ex.en: She went through the company's accounts, looking for evidence of fraud.
ex.cn: 她仔细审查公司的账目，寻找诈骗的证据。

senses.def: to study or consider sth in detail, especially by repeating it
senses.chn: （尤指反复地）详细研究，仔细琢磨

ex.en: Let's go through the arguments again.
ex.cn: 咱们再详细研究一下这些论据吧。

ex.en: Could we go through (= practise) Act 2 once more?
ex.cn: 我们把第 2 幕戏再串一次好吗？

senses.def: to perform a series of actions; to follow a method or procedure
senses.chn: 执行某行动；实行某方法；履行某程序

ex.en: Certain formalities have to be gone through before you can emigrate.
ex.cn: 必须办理一定的手续方能移居他国。

senses.def: to experience or suffer sth

ex.en: She's been going through a bad patch recently.
ex.cn: 她最近很不走运。

ex.en: He's amazingly cheerful considering all he's had to go through.
ex.cn: 经历了种种磨难，他还那么乐观，令人惊叹。

senses.def: to use up or finish sth completely

ex.en: The boys went through two whole loaves of bread.
ex.cn: 这些男孩把整整两条面包吃得精光。

senses.def: to do what is necessary to complete a course of action, especially one that is difficult or unpleasant
senses.chn: 完成艰难（或令人不快）的事

ex.en: She decided not to go through with (= not to have) the operation.
ex.cn: 她决定不动手术。

senses.def: to be given to sb/sth

ex.en: Proceeds from the concert will go to charity.
ex.cn: 音乐会的收入将捐赠给慈善事业。

ex.en: All her property went to her eldest son (= when she died).
ex.cn: （她死后）全部财产由她的长子继承了。

senses.def: to be used as part of the payment for sth
senses.chn: 用于支付…的部分款项；作为对…的部分付款

ex.en: The money will go towards a new car.
ex.cn: 这笔钱将用于支付新车的部分款项。

ex.en: Part of my pay cheque went towards buying an MP3 player.
ex.cn: 我的部分工资用于买 MP3 播放器了。

senses.def: to sink below the surface
to become bankrupt (= be unable to pay what you owe)

ex.en: The firm will go under unless business improves.
ex.cn: 生意若无起色，公司将会倒闭。

senses.def: to be built

ex.en: New office buildings are going up everywhere.
ex.cn: 到处都在兴建新办公楼。

senses.def: when the curtain across the stage in a theatre goes up, it is raised or opened
to be destroyed by fire or an explosion

ex.en: The whole building went up in flames.
ex.cn: 整座楼房在大火中焚毁。

senses.def: if the price of sth, the temperature, etc. goes up, it becomes higher

ex.en: The price of cigarettes is going up.
ex.cn: 香烟价格在上涨。

ex.en: Cigarettes are going up in price.
ex.cn: 香烟在涨价。

senses.def: to arrive at a university, especially Oxford or Cambridge, at the beginning of a term or in order to begin your studies
senses.chn: （大学开学时）到校上学（尤指牛津和剑桥）

senses.def: to go from one place to another, especially further north or to a city or large town from a smaller place
senses.chn: （从一处）到（另一处）（尤指北上或从小地方到城市或大城镇）

ex.en: When are you next going up to Scotland?
ex.cn: 你下次什么时候北上苏格兰？

ex.en: We went up to London last weekend.
ex.cn: 我们上周末上伦敦去了。

senses.def: to have a sexual or romantic relationship with sb
senses.chn: 与某人有性关系；与某人谈恋爱

senses.def: to have sex with sb
to be included with or as part of sth

ex.en: A car goes with the job.
ex.cn: 这份工作配有一辆汽车。

senses.def: to agree to accept sth, for example a plan or an offer

ex.en: You're offering £500? I think we can go with that.
ex.cn: 你出价 500 英镑？我想我们可以接受。

senses.def: to combine well with sth
senses.chn: 与某物相配（或协调、和谐）

ex.en: Does this jacket go with this skirt?
ex.cn: 这件上衣与这条裙子相配吗？

ex.en: Those colours don't really go (together).
ex.cn: 那些颜色并不十分协调。

senses.def: to exist at the same time or in the same place as sth; to be found together
senses.chn: 与某事同时（或同地）存在；与某事相伴而生

ex.en: Disease often goes with poverty.
ex.cn: 疾病与贫穷常常相伴而生。

ex.en: Disease and poverty often go together.
ex.cn: 疾病与贫穷常常相伴而生。

senses.def: to manage without sth that you usually have or need
senses.chn: 没有…而勉强应付；没有…也行

ex.en: There wasn't time for breakfast, so I had to go without.
ex.cn: 没有时间吃早饭，我只好不吃了。

ex.en: How long can a human being go (= survive) without sleep?
ex.cn: 人不睡觉能活多久？

ex.en: She went without eating for three days.
ex.cn: 她三天没吃东西。

senses.def: a person's turn to move or play in a game or an activity

ex.en: Whose go is it?
ex.cn: 轮到谁了？

ex.en: It's your go.
ex.cn: 轮到你啦。

ex.en: 'How much is it to play?' 'It's 50p a go.'
ex.cn: “玩这游戏多少钱？” “ 50 便士一回。”

ex.en: Can I have a go on your new bike?
ex.cn: 我能骑骑你的新自行车吗？

senses.def: an attempt at doing sth

ex.en: It took three goes to get it right.
ex.cn: 试了三次才把它弄好。

ex.en: I doubt if he'll listen to advice from me, but I'll give it a go (= I'll try but I don't think I will succeed).
ex.cn: 我怀疑他是不是会听我劝，不过我想试试看。

senses.def: energy and enthusiasm

ex.en: Mary's always got plenty of go.
ex.cn: 玛丽总是精力充沛。

senses.def: in one single attempt or try

ex.en: She blew out the candles at one go.
ex.cn: 她一口气把蜡烛全吹灭了。

senses.def: to be planned and possible or allowed

ex.en: I'm not sure if Friday's trip is a go.
ex.cn: 我说不准星期五是否能成行。

senses.def: to be very busy or full of activity
senses.chn: 忙得要命；事儿特别多；手忙脚乱

ex.en: It was all go in the office today.
ex.cn: 今天办公室里忙得要死。

senses.def: to be very active and busy

ex.en: I've been on the go all day.
ex.cn: 我一整天忙得马不停蹄。

ex.en: Having four children keeps her on the go.
ex.cn: 她那四个孩子把她忙得不可开交。

senses.def: at the first, second, etc. attempt
senses.chn: 第一次（或第二次等）尝试

ex.en: I passed my driving test first go.
ex.cn: 我考驾照一次就通过了。

senses.def: to attack sb physically

ex.en: There were about seven of them standing round him, all waiting to have a go.
ex.cn: 他们大约有七个人把他围起来，个个都等着下手。

senses.def: to make an attempt to do sth

ex.en: 'I can't start the engine.' 'Let me have a go.'
ex.cn: “这发动机我发动不起来了。” “让我来试试。”

ex.en: I'll have a go at fixing it tonight.
ex.cn: 我今晚试着修一下。

senses.def: to criticize sb or complain about sb

ex.en: The boss had a go at me for being late for work.
ex.cn: 我上班迟到，老板剋了我一顿。

senses.def: to be in the middle of an activity or a project

ex.en: The award-winning novelist often has three or four books on the go at once.
ex.cn: 那位获奖小说家经常是三四部小说同时写的。

senses.def: all together on one occasion

ex.en: I'd rather do the journey in one go, and not stop on the way.
ex.cn: 我宁愿一次走完全程，中途不停。

ex.en: They ate the packet of biscuits all in one go.
ex.cn: 他们一下子把那包饼干全吃光了。

senses.def: to be successful in sth
senses.chn: 在…方面成功（或有所成就）

ex.en: We've had a few problems in our marriage, but we're both determined to make a go of it.
ex.cn: 我们的婚姻有过一些问题，但现在我们俩都决心好好过日子。

senses.def: to stop holding on to sth

ex.en: Leave go of my arm—you're hurting me!
ex.cn: 放开我的手臂，你弄痛我了！

senses.def: to stop holding sb/sth

ex.en: Don't let the rope go.
ex.cn: 别松开绳子。

ex.en: Don't let go of the rope.
ex.cn: 别松开绳子。

ex.en: Let go! You're hurting me!
ex.cn: 放手！你把我弄疼了！

senses.def: to give up an idea or an attitude, or control of sth
senses.chn: 放弃，摒弃（想法、态度或控制）

ex.en: It's time to let the past go.
ex.cn: 该忘掉过去了。

ex.en: It's time to let go of the past.
ex.cn: 该忘掉过去了。

example.en: She went into her room and shut the door behind her.
example.cn: 她走进自己的房间，把门关上。

example.en: She has gone to see her sister this weekend.
example.cn: 她本周末看她姐姐去了。

example.en: We had gone about fifty miles when the car broke down.
example.cn: 我们行驶了约莫五十英里，汽车突然抛锚了。

example.en: 3 into 12 goes 4 times.
7 won't go into 15.
example.cn: 7 除不尽 15。

example.en: She went to sleep.
example.cn: 她睡着了。

example.en: That colour has gone out of fashion.
example.cn: 那种颜色已不时兴了。

example.en: The story goes that she's been married five times.
example.cn: 据传她结过五次婚。

senses.def: to continue to do sth; to keep busy with sth

ex.en: Despite the threat of war, people went about their business as usual.
ex.cn: 虽然有可能发生战争，人们照常忙着自己的事。

senses.def: to do the things that you normally do
senses.chn: 忙自己的事；做通常做的事

ex.en: streets filled with people going about their daily business
ex.cn: 挤满为日常生活奔忙的人的街道

senses.def: to keep irritating or annoying sb/sth until they react

ex.en: Goaded beyond endurance, she turned on him and hit out.
ex.cn: 她被气得忍无可忍，于是转身向他猛击。

ex.en: He finally goaded her into answering his question.
ex.cn: 他终于激得她回答了他的问题。

senses.def: to drive or encourage sb to do sth

ex.en: The boxers were goaded on by the shrieking crowd.
ex.cn: 拳击运动员听见观众的喊叫就来劲儿了。

senses.def: a pointed stick used for making cows, etc. move forwards
something that makes sb do sth, usually by annoying them
senses.chn: （意在惹恼某人而促其行动的）刺激，激励

example.en: Goaded beyond endurance, she turned on him and hit out.
example.cn: 她被气得忍无可忍，于是转身向他猛击。

phrases.filled: goad sb/sth into sth/into doing sth

example.en: He finally goaded her into answering his question.
example.cn: 他终于激得她回答了他的问题。

senses.def: to chase or follow sb
senses.chn: 追赶某人；跟在某人后面

ex.en: He went after the burglars.
ex.cn: 他追赶那些窃贼。

ex.en: She left the room in tears so I went after her.
ex.cn: 她流着泪离开了房间，于是我跟着追了出去。

senses.def: to not be in sb's favour or not to their advantage
senses.chn: 对某人不利；不利于某人

ex.en: The jury's verdict went against him.
ex.cn: 陪审团的裁定对他不利。

senses.def: to be opposed to sth; to not fit or agree with sth

ex.en: Paying for hospital treatment goes against her principles.
ex.cn: 拿钱到医院治病有违她的原则。

ex.en: His thinking goes against all logic.
ex.cn: 他的想法完全不合情理。

senses.def: to travel in front of other people in your group and arrive before them

ex.en: I'll go ahead and tell them you're on the way.
ex.cn: 我要先走一步，告诉他们你在路上。

senses.def: to happen; to be done

ex.en: The building of the new bridge will go ahead as planned.
ex.cn: 新桥的修建将按计划进行。

senses.def: permission for sb to start doing sth

ex.en: The council has given the go-ahead to start building.
ex.cn: 委员会已批准破土动工。

senses.def: willing to try new ideas, methods, etc. and therefore likely to succeed
senses.chn: 有进取心的；有开拓精神的

ex.en: a go-ahead company
ex.cn: 开拓型公司

senses.def: a frame with a net into which players must kick or hit the ball in order to score a point

ex.en: He headed the ball into an open goal (= one that had nobody defending it).
ex.cn: 他把球顶进了空门。

ex.en: Who is in goal (= is the goalkeeper ) for Arsenal?
ex.cn: 阿森纳队的守门员是谁？

senses.def: the act of kicking or hitting the ball into the goal; a point that is scored for this

ex.en: The winning goal was scored by Hill.
ex.cn: 希尔踢进了致胜的一球。

ex.en: Liverpool won by three goals to one.
ex.cn: 利物浦队以三比一获胜。

ex.en: United conceded two goals in the first half.
ex.cn: 联队在上半场被攻入了两球。

ex.en: a penalty goal
ex.cn: 点球罚中

senses.def: something that you hope to achieve

ex.en: to work towards a goal
ex.cn: 争取达到目标

ex.en: to achieve/attain a goal
ex.cn: 达到目标

ex.en: You need to set yourself some long-term goals.
ex.cn: 你得为自己定一些长期目标。

ex.en: Our ultimate goal must be the preservation of the environment.
ex.cn: 我们的最终目的必须是保护好环境。

ex.en: Set yourself targets that you can reasonably hope to achieve.
ex.cn: 给自己制订有望达到的指标。

ex.en: attainment targets in schools
ex.cn: 学校的成绩目标

senses.def: a player whose job is to stop the ball from going into his or her own team's goal
a kick taken by one team after the ball has been kicked over their goal line by the other team without a goal being scored
without either team scoring a goal

ex.en: The match ended in a goalless draw.
ex.cn: 比赛以零比零结束。

senses.def: the line at either end of a sports field on which the goal stands or which the ball must cross to score a goal or touchdown
to make a very great effort to get sth or do sth
senses.chn: 竭力获取某物；全力以赴做某事；鼓足干劲做某事

go all out to do sth.lemma: go all out to do sth

senses.def: to make a very great effort to get sth or do sth
senses.chn: 竭力获取某物；全力以赴做某事；鼓足干劲做某事

senses.def: to do sth or ask a question in a very complicated way instead of in a simple, direct way
senses.chn: 绕圈子；拐弯抹角；不直截了当

senses.def: the area directly in front of a goal
to continue with an activity

ex.en: He made up the story as he went along.
ex.cn: 这个故事是他现编现讲的。

senses.def: to make progress; to develop

ex.en: Things are going along nicely.
ex.cn: 情况进展良好。

senses.def: to last a long time

ex.en: She seems to make her money go a long way.
ex.cn: 看起来她用钱细水长流。

ex.en: A small amount of this paint goes a long way (= covers a large area).
ex.cn: 这种涂料用一点就可涂一大片。

ex.en: I find that a little of Jerry's company can go a long way (= I quickly get tired of being with him).
ex.cn: 我发觉跟杰里待上一会儿就受不了啦。

senses.def: one of the two vertical posts that form part of a goal
to change the rules for sth, or conditions under which it is done, so that the situation becomes more difficult for sb
senses.chn: 改变规则，改变条件（使某人为难）

senses.def: a player in a sports game who scores a goal
senses.chn: （体育比赛的）得分队员，得分射手，得分者

senses.def: used to show that you are angry or annoyed that sb has done sth stupid
senses.chn: （对某人做了蠢事感到愤怒或烦恼）竟然干出某事，居然干出某事

ex.en: Trust him to go and mess things up!
ex.cn: 就知道他会把事情弄得一团糟！

ex.en: Why did you have to go and upset your mother like that?
ex.cn: 你干吗非得让你母亲那样伤心呢？

ex.en: You've really gone and done it (= done sth very stupid) now!
ex.cn: 你竟然干出这样的事来！

senses.def: a path taken by a plane after an unsuccessful attempt at landing, in order to get into a suitable position to try to land again
a disagreement or argument
to become lost; to be stolen

ex.en: Several letters went astray or were not delivered.
ex.cn: 有几封信丢失或未投递。

ex.en: We locked up our valuables so they would not go astray.
ex.cn: 我们把贵重物品锁了起来以免被盗。

senses.def: to go in the wrong direction or to have the wrong result

ex.en: Fortunately the gunman's shots went astray.
ex.cn: 幸好持枪歹徒把子弹打偏了。

ex.en: Jack's parents thought the other boys might lead him astray (= make him do things that are wrong).
ex.cn: 杰克的父母认为，其他的男孩可能会把他引入歧途。

senses.def: an animal with horns and a coat of hair, that lives wild in mountain areas or is kept on farms for its milk or meat

ex.en: a mountain goat
ex.cn: 山羊

ex.en: goat's milk/cheese
ex.cn: 羊奶；羊奶酪

senses.def: an unpleasant old man who is annoying in a sexual way
to annoy sb very much
to distinguish people who are good at sth, intelligent, etc. from those who are not
senses.chn: 区分能手与常人；分清智者和庸人

senses.def: a small pointed beard (= hair growing on a man's face) that is grown only on the chin
a person whose job is to take care of a group of goats
to attack sb

ex.en: They went at each other furiously.
ex.cn: 他们相互猛烈攻击。

senses.def: leather made from the skin of a goat
to make great efforts to do sth; to work hard at sth

ex.en: They went at the job as if their lives depended on it.
ex.cn: 他们干起活来好像性命攸关似的。

senses.def: to leave a person or place

ex.en: Just go away!

ex.cn: “汤姆在这儿吗？” “不在，我来之前他就走了。”

senses.def: used to say that a particular situation no longer exists

ex.en: The days are gone when you could leave your door unlocked at night.
ex.cn: 夜不闭户的时代已经一去不复返了。

senses.def: having been pregnant for the length of time mentioned

ex.en: She's seven months gone.
ex.cn: 她怀孕七个月了。

ex.en: How far gone are you?
ex.cn: 你怀孕多久了？

senses.def: said by an auctioneer to show that an item has been sold
to be dead

ex.en: You'll be sorry you said that when I'm dead and gone.
ex.cn: 我死后你会为你说的话感到后悔的。

senses.def: later than the time mentioned

ex.en: It's gone six already.
ex.cn: 已经过六点了。

senses.def: lost or destroyed
a person who is going to die soon or who cannot be saved from a dangerous situation
senses.chn: 垂死的人；快完蛋的人；无法挽救的人

ex.en: We were frantic. We thought you were a goner.
ex.cn: 我们急死了，以为你快没命了。

senses.def: a round piece of metal that hangs in a frame and makes a loud deep sound when it is hit with a stick. Gongs are used as musical instruments or to give signals, for example that a meal is ready.
an award or medal given to sb for the work they have done
a way of saying or writing 'going to' in informal speech, when it refers to the future
senses.chn: 即将，将要（非正式用语，即 going to）

ex.en: What's she gonna do now?
ex.cn: 她现在要干什么？

senses.def: if you tell sb that a secret will go no further, you promise not to tell it to anyone else
a disease of the sexual organs, caught by having sex with an infected person
reporting in newspapers that tries to shock or excite readers rather than to give true information
senses.chn: 哗众取宠的新闻报道；新闻炒作

senses.def: any unpleasant sticky wet substance
of high quality or an acceptable standard
senses.chn: 好的；优质的；符合标准的；可接受的

ex.en: a good book
ex.cn: 一本好书

ex.en: good food
ex.cn: 符合标准的食品

ex.en: The piano was in good condition.
ex.cn: 这台钢琴状况良好。

ex.en: Your work is just not good enough.
ex.cn: 你的工作就是不够好。

ex.en: The results were pretty good.
ex.cn: 结果相当不错。

ex.en: Sorry, my English is not very good.
ex.cn: 对不起，我的英语不太好。

senses.def: pleasant; that you enjoy or want
senses.chn: 令人愉快的；令人满意的

ex.en: Did you have a good time in London?
ex.cn: 你在伦敦过得愉快吗？

ex.en: It's good to see you again.
ex.cn: 再次见到你真高兴。

ex.en: This is very good news.
ex.cn: 这消息真叫人高兴。

ex.en: Let's hope we have good weather tomorrow.
ex.cn: 希望明天是个好天。

ex.en: We are still friends, though, which is good.
ex.cn: 不过我们仍然是朋友，这令人感到欣慰。

ex.en: It's a good thing (= it's lucky) you came early.
ex.cn: 幸好你来得早。

senses.def: sensible, logical or strongly supporting what is being discussed
senses.chn: 合情理的；有说服力的；有充分根据的

ex.en: Thank you, good question.
ex.cn: 谢谢，问题提得好。

ex.en: Yes, that's a good point.
ex.cn: 是的，那是个有说服力的论据。

ex.en: I have good reason to be suspicious.
ex.cn: 我的怀疑有充分理由。

ex.en: What a good idea!
ex.cn: 多好的主意啊！

senses.def: showing or getting approval or respect
senses.chn: 赞同的；赢得赞许的；令人尊敬的

ex.en: The play had good reviews.
ex.cn: 这部戏受到好评。

ex.en: The hotel has a good reputation.
ex.cn: 这家旅馆声誉良好。

ex.en: He comes from a good family.
ex.cn: 他出身名门。

senses.def: able to do sth well
senses.chn: 能干的；精通的；娴熟的；擅长于…的

ex.en: to be a good actor/cook
ex.cn: 是优秀的演员／出色的厨师

ex.en: to be good at languages/your job
ex.cn: 精通多种语言；工作熟练

ex.en: Nick has always been good at finding cheap flights.
ex.cn: 尼克总能找到价格便宜的航班。

senses.def: able to use sth or deal with people well
senses.chn: 灵巧的；精明的；善于应付…的

ex.en: She's good with her hands (= able to make things, etc.).
ex.cn: 她手很巧。

ex.en: He's very good with children.
ex.cn: 他对孩子很有一套。

senses.def: morally right; behaving in a way that is morally right
senses.chn: 符合道德的；正派的；高尚的

ex.en: She has tried to lead a good life.
ex.cn: 她努力规规矩矩地生活。

ex.en: a good deed
ex.cn: 高尚的行为

ex.en: Giving her that money was a good thing to do.
ex.cn: 把那笔钱给她是做了一件善事。

senses.def: following strictly a set of rules or principles

ex.en: It is good practice to supply a written report to the buyer.
ex.cn: 向买主提供书面报告是诚信的做法。

ex.en: She was a good Catholic girl.
ex.cn: 她是个虔诚的天主教徒。

senses.def: willing to help; showing kindness to other people
senses.chn: 助人为乐的；心地善良的；好心的

ex.en: He was very good to me when I was ill.
ex.cn: 我生病时他对我关怀备至。

ex.en: It was very good of you to come.
ex.cn: 你能来真是太好了。

ex.en: I had to take a week off work but my colleagues were very good about it.
ex.cn: 我得请一周的假，同事们对此非常谅解。

senses.def: behaving well or politely

ex.en: You can stay up late if you're good.
ex.cn: 你要是听话就可以晚一点睡觉。

ex.en: Get dressed now, there's a good girl.
ex.cn: 现在把衣服穿好，乖孩子。

senses.def: healthy or strong

ex.en: Can you speak into my good ear?
ex.cn: 对着我这只没毛病的耳朵说好吗？

ex.en: I don't feel too good today.
ex.cn: 我今天感觉不太舒服。

ex.en: 'How are you?' 'I'm good.' (= used as a general reply to a greeting)
ex.cn: “你好吗？” “我很好。”

senses.def: having a useful or helpful effect on sb/sth

ex.en: Too much sun isn't good for you.
ex.cn: 晒太阳太多对你并没有好处。

ex.en: It's probably good for you to get some criticism now and then.
ex.cn: 偶尔受点批评或许对你还有好处。

ex.en: Shut your mouth, if you know what's good for you (= used as a threat).
ex.cn: 你不想找麻烦就把嘴闭上。

senses.def: not having a useful or helpful effect

ex.en: It's no good complaining—they never listen.
ex.cn: 抱怨毫无用处，他们根本不听。

ex.en: This book is no good to me: I need the new edition.
ex.cn: 这本书对我没用，我需要新版本的。

senses.def: suitable or appropriate
senses.chn: 合适的；适宜的；恰当的；适合…的

ex.en: Now is a good time to buy a house.
ex.cn: 现在买房子正是时候。

ex.en: She would be good for the job.
ex.cn: 她干这工作很合适。

ex.en: Can we change our meeting? Monday isn't good (= convenient) for me.
ex.cn: 我们把见面时间改改吧，星期一我不方便。

senses.def: used to show that you approve of or are pleased about sth that has been said or done, or to show that you want to move on to a new topic of conversation
senses.chn: （表示赞同、满意或转向新的话题）

ex.en: 'Dinner's ready.' 'Good—I'm starving.'
ex.cn: “晚饭好了。” “太好了，我正饿得很。”

ex.en: 'I got the job.' 'Oh, good.'
ex.cn: “我得到这工作了。” “啊，太好了。”

ex.en: Good, I think we've come to a decision.
ex.cn: 好的，我们就这样决定吧。

senses.def: used as a form of praise

ex.en: Good old Jack!
ex.cn: 好心的杰克！

ex.en: 'I've ordered some drinks.' 'Good man!'
ex.cn: “我叫了些饮料。” “真是好人！”

senses.def: used in exclamations

ex.en: Good heavens!
ex.cn: 天啊！

ex.en: Good God!
ex.cn: 上帝呀！

senses.def: great in number, amount or degree
senses.chn: （数量或程度）相当大的，相当多的

ex.en: a good many people
ex.cn: 相当多的人

ex.en: The kitchen is a good size.
ex.cn: 这厨房相当大。

ex.en: We spent a good while (= quite a long time) looking for the house.
ex.cn: 我们花了好长时间找这房子。

ex.en: He devoted a good deal of (= a lot of) attention to the problem.
ex.cn: 他在这个问题上花了相当多的精力。

ex.en: There's a good chance (= it is likely) that I won't be here next year.
ex.cn: 我明年很可能不在这儿。

senses.def: not less than; rather more than

ex.en: We waited for a good hour.
ex.cn: 我们等了足足一小时。

ex.en: It's a good three miles to the station.
ex.cn: 到车站至少有三英里。

senses.def: thorough; complete

ex.en: We had a good laugh about it afterwards.
ex.cn: 我们后来对此笑了个痛快。

ex.en: You'll feel better after a good sleep.
ex.cn: 好好睡上一觉你会感觉好些。

senses.def: amusing

ex.en: a good story/joke
ex.cn: 有趣的故事／笑话

ex.en: That's a good one!
ex.cn: 那真有意思！

senses.def: having enough energy, health, strength, etc. to last for a particular length of time or distance
senses.chn: （精力、健康、力量等）足以维持…的，能持续…的

ex.en: You're good for (= you will live) a few years yet.
ex.cn: 你还可以活上几年。

senses.def: valid for sth

ex.en: The ticket is good for three months.
ex.cn: 这张票三个月内有效。

senses.def: likely to provide sth

ex.en: He's always good for a laugh.
ex.cn: 他总能逗人发笑。

ex.en: Bobby should be good for a few drinks.
ex.cn: 博比喝上几杯应该是没问题的。

senses.def: very nearly
senses.chn: 与…几乎一样；几乎；简直是

ex.en: The matter is as good as settled.
ex.cn: 这事实际上可以说解决了。

ex.en: He as good as called me a coward (= suggested that I was a coward without actually using the word 'coward').
ex.cn: 他就差说我是懦夫了。

senses.def: used when you are saying that a situation is not going to get any better
senses.chn: （形势）不会有什么好转，还是老样子

senses.def: several

ex.en: There are still a good few empty seats.
ex.cn: 还有好几个空座位。

senses.def: (of a thing) to be prepared and ready for use; (of a person) to be prepared and ready to do something

ex.en: By tomorrow afternoon the document will be good to go.
ex.cn: 到明天下午文件就可以备妥。

ex.en: I've spent several months training for this race so now I'm good to go.
ex.cn: 为了这场比赛我花了几个月的时间训练，现在我准备好了。

senses.def: completely

ex.en: I won't go until I'm good and ready.
ex.cn: 我要完全准备就绪后才走。

senses.def: used to praise sb for doing sth well

ex.en: 'I passed first time.' 'Good for you!'
ex.cn: “我第一次就过了。” “你真行！”

senses.def: behaviour that is morally right or acceptable
senses.chn: 合乎道德的行为；正直的行为；善行

ex.en: the difference between good and evil
ex.cn: 善与恶的区别

ex.en: Is religion always a force for good?
ex.cn: 宗教一向是诲人行善的力量吗？

ex.en: The charity does a lot of good.
ex.cn: 这家慈善机构做很多善事。

ex.en: the difference between good and evil
ex.cn: 善恶之分

ex.en: Her goodness shone through.
ex.cn: 她显然非常善良。

senses.def: people who live a moral life; people who are admired for the work they do to help other people
senses.chn: 有道德的人；高尚的人；好人

ex.en: a gathering of the great and the good
ex.cn: 群贤荟萃

senses.def: something that helps sb/sth

ex.en: Cuts have been made for the good of the company.
ex.cn: 实行裁减是为了公司的利益。

ex.en: I'm only telling you this for your own good.
ex.cn: 我把这事告诉你只是为你好。

ex.en: What's the good of (= how does it help you) earning all that money if you don't have time to enjoy it?
ex.cn: 要是没时间去享受，赚那么多钱有什么用？

ex.en: What good is it redecorating if you're thinking of moving?
ex.cn: 如果你打算搬走，那重新装饰有什么用呢？

senses.def: used to say that if sth happens, it will be good, even if it is not exactly what you were expecting

ex.en: If these measures also reduce unemployment, that is all to the good.
ex.cn: 要是这些措施也能降低失业率，那就不失为好事。

senses.def: to not be useful; to have no useful effect
senses.chn: 没（或没什么、没多大）用处（或好处）

ex.en: This gadget isn't much good.
ex.cn: 这小玩意儿没多大用处。

ex.en: It's no good trying to talk me out of leaving.
ex.cn: 想说服我不要离开是没用的。

ex.en: Was his advice ever any good?
ex.cn: 他的建议有过用处吗？

senses.def: to not be interesting or enjoyable
senses.chn: 没（或没什么、没多大）乐趣

ex.en: His latest film isn't much good.
ex.cn: 他最近拍摄的影片没多大意思。

senses.def: to have a useful effect; to help sb

ex.en: Do you think these latest changes will do any good?
ex.cn: 你认为最近这些变化有什么作用吗？

ex.en: Don't you think talking to her would do some good?
ex.cn: 你不觉得和她谈一谈会有用吗？

ex.en: I'm sure a few days off would do you a power of good (= improve your health).
ex.cn: 休息几天肯定对你的身体大有好处。

senses.def: permanently

ex.en: This time she's leaving for good (= she will never return).
ex.cn: 她这次走是再也不会回来了。

senses.def: used to say that sb now has a particular amount of money that they did not have before

ex.en: We are £500 to the good.
ex.cn: 我们净赚 500 英镑。

senses.def: doing sth wrong or dishonest

ex.en: Those kids are always up to no good.
ex.cn: 那些孩子尽会恶作剧。

senses.def: no problem is so bad that it does not bring some advantage to sb
senses.chn: 没有绝对的坏事；任何坏事都会有利于某些人

senses.def: to be very good for sb's physical or mental health
to make sb feel much better; to improve sth
senses.chn: 使…感到好得多；对…大有好处；改善

ex.en: A change of job would do you the world of good.
ex.cn: 换一下工作会对你大有好处。

senses.def: well

ex.en: 'How's it going?' 'Pretty good.'
ex.cn: “事情进展如何？” “非常好。”

ex.en: Now, you listen to me good!
ex.cn: 喂，好好听我说！

example.en: to be good at languages/your job
example.cn: 精通多种语言；工作熟练

example.en: Nick has always been good at finding cheap flights.
example.cn: 尼克总能找到价格便宜的航班。

example.en: He was very good to me when I was ill.
example.cn: 我生病时他对我关怀备至。

example.en: It was very good of you to come.
example.cn: 你能来真是太好了。

example.en: I had to take a week off work but my colleagues were very good about it.
example.cn: 我得请一周的假，同事们对此非常谅解。

example.en: She would be good for the job.
example.cn: 她干这工作很合适。

example.en: Can we change our meeting? Monday isn't good (= convenient) for me.
example.cn: 我们把见面时间改改吧，星期一我不方便。

senses.def: used to say hello politely when people first see each other in the afternoon; in informal use people often just say Afternoon
senses.chn: （下午见面时用语）下午好，你（们）好（非正式场合常说 Afternoon）

senses.def: completely; thoroughly

ex.en: That's messed things up good and proper.
ex.cn: 这就把事情彻底弄砸了。

senses.def: used when you are leaving sb or when sb else is leaving

ex.en: Goodbye! It was great to meet you.
ex.cn: 再见！认识你很高兴。

ex.en: She didn't even say goodbye to her mother.
ex.cn: 她甚至没有向母亲道个别。

ex.en: We waved them goodbye.
ex.cn: 我们向他们挥手告别。

ex.en: We've already said our goodbyes.
ex.cn: 我们已经道别了。

ex.en: Kiss me goodbye!
ex.cn: 和我吻别吧！

ex.en: Take out our service contract and say goodbye to costly repair bills.
ex.cn: 接受我们的服务合同，告别昂贵的修理费吧。

senses.def: used to say hello or goodbye politely when people first see each other or leave each other during the day
senses.chn: （白天见面或分手时用语）白天好，你（们）好，再见

ex.en: Good day to you.
ex.cn: 你好。

senses.def: used to say hello politely when people first see each other in the evening; in informal use people often just say Evening
senses.chn: （晚上见面时用语）晚上好，你（们）好（非正式场合常说 Evening）

senses.def: the intention to be honest and helpful

ex.en: a gesture of good faith
ex.cn: 善意的表示

ex.en: He acted in good faith.
ex.cn: 他这样做是出于真心诚意。

senses.def: a person who is lazy and has no skills

ex.en: an idle good-for-nothing
ex.cn: 游手好闲的懒虫

senses.def: good for you, even if it seems unpleasant

ex.en: 'Want a ride?' 'No thanks. Walking is good for the soul.'
ex.cn: “搭车吗？” “不，谢谢。步行有步行的好处。”

senses.def: the Friday before Easter, the day when Christians remember the Crucifixion of Christ
senses.chn: 耶稣受难日（复活节前的星期五）

senses.def: used to emphasize what you are saying when you are surprised, shocked or annoyed
senses.chn: （惊讶、震惊或烦恼时说）天哪，啊哟，主啊

ex.en: God, what a stupid thing to do!
ex.cn: 天啊，这事干得太蠢了！

senses.def: kind; willing to help other people
senses.chn: 善良的；好心的；乐于助人的

senses.def: a cheerful mood

ex.en: Everyone admired her patience and unfailing good humour.
ex.cn: 人人都佩服她的耐心和永不衰减的好脾气。

senses.def: quite good rather than very good

ex.en: 'Is the salary good?' 'Goodish.'
ex.cn: “工资还行吧？” “还可以。”

senses.def: quite large in size or amount

ex.en: It'll be a goodish while yet before I've finished.
ex.cn: 我还得花很长时间才能完成。

senses.def: physically attractive

ex.en: a good-looking man/couple
ex.cn: 俊美的男子；漂亮的一对

ex.en: She's strikingly good-looking.
ex.cn: 她非常漂亮。

ex.en: She looked stunningly beautiful that night.
ex.cn: 她那天晚上美极了。

ex.en: She's got a very pretty face.
ex.cn: 她有一张非常俏丽的脸。

ex.en: He was described as ' tall, dark and handsome '.
ex.cn: 他被描述为 “高大黝黑、相貌堂堂”。

ex.en: She's a very attractive woman.
ex.cn: 她是个非常迷人的女子。

senses.def: the physical beauty of a person

ex.en: an actor famous for his rugged good looks
ex.cn: 以其粗犷美而出名的男演员

senses.def: used to say that you do not mind what sb does as it does not affect you, but you hope they will be successful
senses.chn: （与己无关而不介意某人的所为）祝某人成功，祝某人走运

ex.en: It's not something I would care to try myself but if she wants to, good luck to her.
ex.cn: 这件事我自己是不想做的，但如果她想试一试，祝愿她成功。

senses.def: quite large in size or amount

ex.en: a goodly number
ex.cn: 相当大的数目

senses.def: physically attractive; of good quality
senses.chn: 漂亮的；好看的；高质量的

senses.def: a lot of money; money that you earn with hard work

ex.en: Thousands of people paid good money to watch the band perform.
ex.cn: 成千上万的人花很多钱去观看这支乐队的演出。

ex.en: Don't waste good money on that!
ex.cn: 别把血汗钱浪费在那上头！

senses.def: used to say hello politely when people first see each other in the morning (in informal use people often just say Morning in this case); sometimes also used formally when people leave each other in the morning
senses.chn: （上午见面时用语，非正式场合常说 Morning）早上好，上午好，你（们）好；（有时用作上午告别时的正式用语）再见

senses.def: the good opinion that people have of sb/sth

ex.en: He told the police he didn't know her, to protect her good name.
ex.cn: 为了维护她的好名声，他对警察说他不认识她。

ex.en: My election chances are not as important as the good name of the party.
ex.cn: 党的声誉比我当选的机会更重要。

senses.def: the quality of being kind, friendly and patient when dealing with people
senses.chn: 善良的品性；和善的本性；温和的性情

senses.def: kind, friendly and patient when dealing with people
senses.chn: 本性善良的；和蔼可亲的；友好的

ex.en: a good-natured person/discussion
ex.cn: 和蔼可亲的人；友好的讨论

senses.def: good relations that exist between people who live in the same area or between countries that are near each other
the quality of being good

ex.en: the essential goodness of human nature
ex.cn: 人性善良的本质

ex.en: evidence of God's goodness
ex.cn: 上帝仁慈的明证

ex.en: At least have the goodness (= good manners) to look at me when I'm talking to you.
ex.cn: 我对你说话时，你至少应该看着我。

ex.en: The charity does a lot of good.

ex.cn: 现在，包括言论自由在内的基本人权已有了保障。

ex.en: We cannot guarantee (that) our flights will never be delayed.
ex.cn: 我们不能保证我们的所有航班均不误点。

ex.en: The ticket will guarantee you free entry.
ex.cn: 这张票可保证你免费入场。

ex.en: We guarantee to deliver your goods within a week.
ex.cn: 我们保证一周内交货。

senses.def: to give a written promise to replace or repair a product free if it goes wrong
senses.chn: 提供（产品）保修单（免费掉换或修理有问题的产品）

ex.en: This iron is guaranteed for a year against faulty workmanship.
ex.cn: 这种熨斗如有工艺缺陷可保修一年。

senses.def: to make sth certain to happen

ex.en: Tonight's victory guarantees the team's place in the final.
ex.cn: 今晚的胜利确保这个队能进入决赛。

ex.en: These days getting a degree doesn't guarantee you a job.
ex.cn: 如今获得学位并不能保证你有工作。

senses.def: to be certain that sth will happen

ex.en: You can guarantee (that) the children will start being naughty as soon as they have to go to bed.
ex.cn: 可以肯定孩子一到上床睡觉时就不听话了。

senses.def: to agree to be legally responsible for sth or for doing sth, especially for paying back money that sb else owes if they cannot pay it back themselves
senses.chn: 承诺对…负法律责任；为…作担保

ex.en: to guarantee a bank loan
ex.cn: 为银行贷款作保

ex.en: to guarantee to pay sb's debts
ex.cn: 为偿还某人的债务作保

ex.en: I guarantee that he will appear in court.
ex.cn: 我保证他会出庭。

senses.def: to be certain to have a particular result

ex.en: If we try to keep it a secret, she's guaranteed to find out.
ex.cn: 如果我们试图保密，她肯定会发现。

ex.en: That kind of behaviour is guaranteed to make him angry.
ex.cn: 那样的行为肯定会让他生气。

ex.en: It's certain that they will agree.
ex.cn: 他们肯定会同意。

ex.en: They are certain to agree.
ex.cn: 他们肯定会同意。

ex.en: There are bound to be changes when the new system is introduced.
ex.cn: 新系统引进后肯定会有变化。

ex.en: You've done so much work—you're bound to pass the exam.
ex.cn: 你下了这么大功夫，一定能通过考试。

example.en: Career success is no guarantee of happiness.
example.cn: 事业成功并不是幸福的保证。

example.en: There's no guarantee that she'll come (= she may not come).
example.cn: 不能保证她一定会来。

example.en: Basic human rights, including freedom of speech, are now guaranteed.
example.cn: 现在，包括言论自由在内的基本人权已有了保障。

example.en: We cannot guarantee (that) our flights will never be delayed.
example.cn: 我们不能保证我们的所有航班均不误点。

example.en: The ticket will guarantee you free entry.
example.cn: 这张票可保证你免费入场。

example.en: We guarantee to deliver your goods within a week.
example.cn: 我们保证一周内交货。

example.en: I guarantee that he will appear in court.
example.cn: 我保证他会出庭。

senses.def: a person who agrees to be responsible for sb or for making sure that sth happens or is done

ex.en: The United Nations will act as guarantor of the peace settlement.
ex.cn: 联合国将充当和平协议的保证人。

senses.def: a person, such as a soldier, a police officer or a prison officer, who protects a place or people, or prevents prisoners from escaping

ex.en: a security guard
ex.cn: 安全警卫

ex.en: border guards
ex.cn: 边防卫士

ex.en: The prisoner slipped past the guards on the gate and escaped.
ex.cn: 犯人从门卫身旁溜出去逃走了。

ex.en: A guard was posted outside the building.
ex.cn: 建筑物外驻了一名警卫。

senses.def: a group of people, such as soldiers or police officers, who protect sb/sth

ex.en: the captain of the guard
ex.cn: 卫队长

ex.en: the changing of the guard (= when one group replaces another)
ex.cn: 卫队换岗

ex.en: The guard is/are being inspected today.
ex.cn: 今天卫队接受检阅。

ex.en: Fellow airmen provided a guard of honour at his wedding.
ex.cn: 空军战友们为他的婚礼充当仪仗队。

ex.en: The President always travels with an armed guard.
ex.cn: 总统出行总有武装卫队保驾。

senses.def: the act or duty of protecting property, places or people from attack or danger; the act or duty of preventing prisoners from escaping

ex.en: a sentry on guard (= at his or her post, on duty)
ex.cn: 执勤哨兵

ex.en: to do guard duty
ex.cn: 担任警戒任务

ex.en: The escaped prisoner was brought back under armed guard.
ex.cn: 越狱逃犯由武装警卫押回。

ex.en: The terrorist was kept under police guard.
ex.cn: 这名恐怖分子当时在警方的看管之下。

ex.en: One of the men kept guard, while the other broke into the house.
ex.cn: 一人放哨，另一人则闯进了房子里。

senses.def: (in Britain and some other countries) special regiments of soldiers whose original duty was to protect the king or queen
senses.chn: （英国和其他一些国家的）禁军，御林军，近卫军

senses.def: something that covers a part of a person's body or a dangerous part of a machine to prevent injury
senses.chn: 防护罩；防护装置；防护用品

ex.en: Ensure the guard is in place before operating the machine.
ex.cn: 一定要在防护措施做好后才开机器。

senses.def: a position you take to defend yourself, especially in a sport such as boxing or fencing

ex.en: to drop/keep up your guard
ex.cn: 放弃／保持防御姿势

ex.en: In spite of the awkward questions the minister never let his guard fall for a moment.
ex.cn: 尽管遇到些令人尴尬的问题，部长从没有放松警惕。

senses.def: one of the two players on a basketball team who are mainly responsible for staying close to opposing players to stop them from scoring
one of the two players on an American football team who play either side of the centre forward
to be very careful and prepared for sth difficult or dangerous
to watch or protect sb/sth

ex.en: Four soldiers stood guard over the coffin.
ex.cn: 有四名士兵守护灵柩。

senses.def: not careful or prepared for sth difficult or dangerous

ex.en: The lawyer's apparently innocent question was designed to catch the witness off (his) guard.
ex.cn: 律师看似不经意的问题是为了使证人措手不及。

senses.def: to protect property, places or people from attack or danger

ex.en: The dog was guarding its owner's luggage.
ex.cn: 狗守护着主人的行李。

ex.en: political leaders guarded by the police
ex.cn: 由警方保卫的政界领袖们

ex.en: You can't get in; the whole place is guarded.
ex.cn: 你进不去，整个地区都戒备森严。

ex.en: a closely guarded secret
ex.cn: 严守的秘密

senses.def: to prevent prisoners from escaping

ex.en: The prisoners were guarded by soldiers.
ex.cn: 犯人由士兵看守。

senses.def: to take care to prevent sth or to protect yourself from sth

ex.en: to guard against accidents/disease
ex.cn: 防止事故；预防疾病

senses.def: to take care to prevent sth or to protect yourself from sth

ex.en: to guard against accidents/disease
ex.cn: 防止事故；预防疾病

senses.def: a dog that is kept to guard a building
careful; not showing feelings or giving much information
senses.chn: 谨慎的；有保留的；不明确表态的

ex.en: a guarded reply
ex.cn: 谨慎的回答

ex.en: You should be more guarded in what you say to reporters.
ex.cn: 你对记者说话应更谨慎些。

ex.en: They gave the news a guarded welcome (= did not show great enthusiasm about it).
ex.cn: 他们对这消息表示谨慎的欢迎。

senses.def: a building for soldiers who are guarding the entrance to a military camp or for keeping military prisoners in
a person who protects sth

ex.en: Farmers should be guardians of the countryside.
ex.cn: 农民应是农村的守卫者。

ex.en: The police are guardians of law and order.
ex.cn: 警察是法律和治安的护卫者。

senses.def: a person who is legally responsible for the care of another person, especially a child whose parents have died
senses.chn: （尤指双亲已故孩子的）监护人

senses.def: a spirit that some people believe protects and guides them, especially when they are in danger

ex.en: A delightful guide was my guardian angel for the first week of the tour.
ex.cn: 令人愉快的导游是我第一周旅行的守护神。

senses.def: the state or position of being responsible for sb/sth
senses.chn: 监护；监护地位；监护人的身份

senses.def: a rail placed on the edge of a path, a cliff or a boat to protect people and prevent them falling over the edge
a strong low fence or wall at the side of a road or between the two halves of a major road such as a motorway or interstate
senses.chn: （高速公路或州际公路上的）防撞护栏，防撞墙

senses.def: a room for soldiers who are guarding the entrance to a building or for keeping military prisoners in
a soldier in the Guards or in the National Guard in the US
senses.chn: 禁卫军士兵；（美国）国民警卫队士兵

senses.def: the part of a train where the person who is in charge of the train rides
a country in Central America
(a person) from Guatemala
senses.chn: 危地马拉人；危地马拉的；危地马拉人的

senses.def: the fruit of a tropical American tree, with yellow skin and pink flesh
senses.chn: 番石榴（热带美洲水果，黄皮，果肉呈粉红色）

senses.def: various things that are not important

ex.en: All the gubbins that came with the computer is still in the box.
ex.cn: 这台电脑的所有零星配件还在箱子里。

senses.def: connected with the job of state governor in the US

ex.en: a gubernatorial candidate
ex.cn: 州长候选人

ex.en: gubernatorial duties
ex.cn: 州长的职责

senses.def: a type of cow kept for its rich milk
a thick sweater made with dark blue wool that has been specially treated so that it does not let water through, worn originally by fishermen
senses.chn: 格恩西防水羊毛衫（深蓝色，原为渔民所穿）

senses.def: a football sweater, especially one of the type without sleeves worn by Australian Rules players
senses.chn: 足球运动衫；（尤指澳大利亚式橄榄球运动员穿的）运动背心

senses.def: to be recognized as being good (originally meaning to be chosen for a football team)
a member of a small group of soldiers who are not part of an official army and who fight against official soldiers, usually to try to change the government

ex.en: urban guerrillas (= those who fight in towns)
ex.cn: 城市游击队员

ex.en: guerrilla war/warfare (= fought by guerrillas on one or both sides)
ex.cn: 游击战

ex.en: a guerrilla movement
ex.cn: 游击运动

senses.def: organized in an informal way and without official permission or approval
senses.chn: 游击的；非正式的；没有官方认可的

ex.en: Guerrilla actors took to the streets in army fatigues to protest against the war.
ex.cn: 非正式演员穿着士兵服走上街头举行反战示威。

ex.en: guerrilla marketing (= marketing that uses unusual methods in order to achieve the greatest effect for the smallest amount of money)
ex.cn: 游击营销（用不一般的方式以最少金钱取得最大成效）

ex.en: guerrilla gardening (= growing plants on land that you do not own to make it more attractive)
ex.cn: 游击园艺（在不属于自己的土地上栽种植物以美化环境）

senses.def: to try and give an answer or make a judgement about sth without being sure of all the facts

ex.en: I don't really know. I'm just guessing.
ex.cn: 我并不知道，我只是猜测。

ex.en: We can only guess at her reasons for leaving.
ex.cn: 对她离去的原因我们只能猜测。

ex.en: He guessed right/wrong.
ex.cn: 他猜对／错了。

ex.en: I'd guess that she's about 30.
ex.cn: 我估计她大约 30 岁。

ex.en: Can you guess where I've been?
ex.cn: 你能猜出我去什么地方了吗？

ex.en: Can you guess his age?
ex.cn: 你能猜出他的年龄吗？

senses.def: to find the right answer to a question or the truth without knowing all the facts

ex.en: She guessed the answer straight away.
ex.cn: 她一下子就猜中了答案。

ex.en: You'll never guess what she told me.
ex.cn: 你永远猜不到她对我说了什么。

ex.en: You would never guess (that) she had problems. She's always so cheerful.
ex.cn: 你怎么也猜不到她有难以解决的问题。她总是那么乐观。

senses.def: to suppose that sth is true or likely

ex.en: I guess (that) you'll be looking for a new job now.
ex.cn: 我想你现在要找新工作了吧。

ex.en: 'He didn't see me, I guess.'
ex.cn: “我想他没看见我。”

ex.en: 'Are you ready to go?' 'Yeah, I guess so.'
ex.cn: “你准备好出发了吗？” “是的，应该可以了。”

ex.en: 'They aren't coming, then?' ' I guess not.'
ex.cn: “这么说，他们不来了？” “我想是吧。”

senses.def: used to show that you are going to say sth surprising or exciting
senses.chn: （引出令人惊奇或激动的事）你猜

ex.en: Guess what! He's asked me out!
ex.cn: 你猜怎么着！他约我出去了！

ex.en: Guess who I've just seen!
ex.cn: 你猜我刚才见到谁了！

senses.def: to not tell sb about your plans or what is going to happen next
senses.chn: 让某人捉摸不定（或猜不透）

ex.en: It's the kind of book that keeps you guessing right to the end.
ex.cn: 这是一本让你从头猜到尾的书。

senses.def: an attempt to give an answer or an opinion when you cannot be certain if you are right

ex.en: to have/make a guess (at sth)
ex.cn: （对某事）作猜测

ex.en: to take a guess
ex.cn: 推测

ex.en: Go on! Have a guess!
ex.cn: 继续！猜猜看！

ex.en: The article is based on guesses about what might happen in the future.
ex.cn: 这篇文章的依据是对未来可能发生什么事情的猜测。

ex.en: They might be here by 3—but that's just a rough guess (= not exact).
ex.cn: 他们可能 3 点钟到，不过这只是一个大致的猜测。

ex.en: My guess is that we won't hear from him again.
ex.cn: 我想我们再不会收到他的消息了。

senses.def: something that nobody can be certain about

ex.en: What will happen next is anybody's guess.
ex.cn: 下一步会发生什么事，谁也说不准。

senses.def: used to tell sb that you do not know any more about a subject than the person that you are talking to does
senses.chn: 我和你一样不知道；我和你一样心中无数

ex.en: 'Who's going to win?' 'Your guess is as good as mine.'
ex.cn: “谁会赢？” “我和你一样不知道。”

senses.def: a guess that is based on some degree of knowledge, and is therefore likely to be correct
to make a mistake

ex.en: Unless I miss my guess, your computer needs a new hard drive.
ex.cn: 我的判断没错的话，你的电脑需要更换一个新的硬盘驱动器。

example.en: We can only guess at her reasons for leaving.
example.cn: 对她离去的原因我们只能猜测。

example.en: He guessed right/wrong.

example.en: You'll never guess what she told me.
example.cn: 你永远猜不到她对我说了什么。

example.en: Guess who I've just seen!

example.en: to have/make a guess (at sth)

example.cn: 这篇文章的依据是对未来可能发生什么事情的猜测。

example.en: My guess is that we won't hear from him again.
example.cn: 我想我们再不会收到他的消息了。

senses.def: a game in which you have to guess the answers to questions
a situation in which you do not know what is going to happen or what sb is going to do
an attempt to calculate sth that is based more on guessing than on information
the process of trying to find an answer by guessing when you do not have enough information to be sure

ex.en: It was pure guesswork on our part.
ex.cn: 这纯属我们的猜测。

senses.def: a person that you have invited to your house or to a particular event that you are paying for

ex.en: We have guests staying this weekend.
ex.cn: 这周末我家有客人来住。

ex.en: more than 100 wedding guests
ex.cn: 100 多位出席婚礼的宾客

ex.en: I went to the theatre club as Helen's guest.
ex.cn: 海伦请我去戏剧俱乐部看戏了。

ex.en: He was the guest of honour (= the most important person invited to an event).
ex.cn: 他是贵宾。

ex.en: Liz was not on the guest list.
ex.cn: 利兹不在邀请之列。

senses.def: a person who is staying at a hotel, etc.

ex.en: We have accommodation for 500 guests.
ex.cn: 我们有可供 500 位客人住宿的房间。

ex.en: a paying guest (= a person who is living in a private house, but paying as if they were in a hotel)
ex.cn: 寄宿客（付费住在私人家中的人）

ex.en: Guests should vacate their rooms by 10.30 a.m.
ex.cn: 房客应在上午 10:30 以前腾出房间。

senses.def: a famous person or performer who takes part in a television show or concert

ex.cn: 特约艺人／明星／歌手

ex.cn: 今晚我们的特别嘉宾是…

ex.en: He made a guest appearance on the show.
ex.cn: 他在这个节目里客串出场。

senses.def: a person who is invited to a particular place or organization, or to speak at a meeting

ex.cn: 出席的科学家是我国政府的贵宾。

ex.cn: 特邀演讲人

senses.def: used to give sb permission to do sth that they have asked to do

ex.cn: “可以用一下电话吗？” “请便。”

ex.cn: 她访问英国时做过几个访谈节目的特邀嘉宾。

senses.chn: （酒吧里常折价限时供应的）款待啤酒

senses.def: a bedroom that is kept for guests to use

senses.chn: （通常指来自穷国的）客籍工人，外籍工作人员

senses.def: to laugh noisily

ex.cn: 他们听了他的笑话都一阵狂笑。

senses.def: the abbreviation for 'graphical user interface' (a way of giving instructions to a computer using things that can be seen on the screen such as symbols and menus)
senses.chn: 图形用户界面（全写为 graphical user interface）

senses.def: help or advice that is given to sb, especially by sb older or with more experience

ex.en: guidance for teachers on how to use video in the classroom
ex.cn: 为教师提供的课堂录像教学指导

ex.en: Activities all take place under the guidance of an experienced tutor.
ex.cn: 所有活动都在经验丰富的导师指导下进行。

ex.en: a guidance counselor (= sb who advises students)
ex.cn: （学生）咨询顾问

senses.def: the process of controlling the direction of a rocket, etc., using electronic equipment

ex.en: a missile guidance system
ex.cn: 导弹制导系统

senses.def: a book, magazine, etc. that gives you information, help or instructions about sth

ex.cn: 家庭健康指南

ex.cn: 咱们看一下节目表，好知道电视上在放些什么。

ex.cn: 意大利旅游指南

ex.en: travel guides
ex.cn: 旅行手册

ex.en: a tour guide
ex.cn: 导游

ex.cn: 我们雇了一名当地人做向导带领我们翻山越岭。

senses.def: a person who advises you on how to live and behave

ex.en: a spiritual guide
ex.cn: 灵修指导者

ex.cn: 大致定个标准，就是每人半杯米。

ex.cn: 我是跟着感觉走。

to show sb the way to a place, often by going with them; to show sb a place that you know well
senses.chn: 给某人领路（或导游）；指引

ex.en: She guided us through the busy streets to the cathedral.
ex.cn: 她带领我们穿过繁忙的街道去大教堂。

ex.en: We were guided around the museums.
ex.cn: 我们在导游的带领下参观了博物馆。

senses.def: to direct or influence sb's behaviour

ex.en: He was always guided by his religious beliefs.
ex.cn: 他的言行总是以自己的宗教信仰为依归。
